title: Shiraishi An — Card Story

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
Hey, have you heard about that rumor?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: A student from the next class fainted in the courtyard yesterday evening.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? That happened?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. The student was brought to the nurse's office and regained consciousness soon, but...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We're all wondering if it could be the handiwork of a ghost!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
You've heard that rumor before, right?
About the female ghost in the courtyard?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, I don't know the details, but I have heard the rumors. But then again, ghosts don't exist, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's what I hope...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Aren't you afraid of ghosts?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope. After all, they don't exist.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey there, everyone! Morning!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki! Morning to you.
Didn't know you were coming in today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I felt like coming to school, so I did♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, what's everyone talking so excitedly about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, yes. The rumor about the ghost in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Someone fainted there yesterday, and everyone's wondering if the ghost could have done it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aha! I know about that rumor, too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even though you never come to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I'm super sensitive to rumors of any sort, see. Doesn't seem like you know all the details, then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I don't know what kind of ghost and stuff.
Not that I'm interested...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Allow me to give you a special rundown!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no need!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That day, a female student was passing through the courtyard in order to run an errand for a teacher.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The courtyard was empty because it was evening...
Yet, the student could hear a woman wailing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She was probably just imagining things...
Maybe it was actually the voice of someone doing club activities?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
If only...
Did you know that the courtyard of this school used to be a cemetery?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The wailing sounded soft at first, but then it got louder and louder, until it felt like there was someone right next to her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Gulp...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The student steeled herself and turned around.
But there was no one there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, as she was breathing a sigh of relief, she saw it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Saw what?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A pale, white hand protruding out from the ground, wrapped around her ankle!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And just like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The girl fainted there and then. And when she woke up, she was lying on a bed in the nurse's office. The end♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-That means, the student next door really fainted in the courtyard because of that ghost?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait a minute? Why's your face so pale?
Are you maybe actually afraid of ghosts?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-N-No way! Never!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, really...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, by the way, Do you think you could help me out with something after school today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The teacher asked me to run an errand, but it's gonna take a while for me to do it by myself. I'd appreciate some help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Errand?
Well, I don't have anything on after school today, so I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you!
See you after school, then!
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Of all the times to be at the courtyard, it just had to be right after hearing that creepy story...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're supposed to go to that storeroom there...
Hm. Isn't it a little too quiet here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? I-Is it?
Seems normal to me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, what did the teacher ask you to do? That storeroom's where the equipment for the sports clubs are being kept...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki? Hey, why the sudden silence?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shh! Did you hear that? A woman's voice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! I-It has to be from someone from the sports clubs...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not! Listen... Those uhh...uhh... sounds...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And...the sounds are getting closer!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You're joking, right? I don't hear anything at all—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo! An, there's a white hand around your ankle!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hyaaah?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What? I'm...I'm fine?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I knew it. You're terrified of ghosts!
Man, I never thought I'd see the day when I'd be hearing An go, Hyaaah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Tsk! You tricked me?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yups. That story was totally made up by yours truly♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why, you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see. An's afraid of ghosts, huh?
Everyone needs to know about this♪ Are they all still in the classroom?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, stop it! Don't go around spreading strange rumors!
Stop, I said!
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, morning!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hey. You're on hall monitor duty today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. I'm catching latecomers today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not late yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, don't worry.
I didn't call you because of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm just not used to seeing you by yourself because you're always together with Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito joined the soccer club's morning practice as a helper.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Helper, huh? I didn't know he did stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, the shop's undergoing inspection today, so it won't be open. Don't bother dropping by.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. I'll let Akito know too.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: An, I didn't know you were a friend of Aoyagi?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, he's a regular at my father's shop, that's all.
I only found out we were in the same school recently.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you should focus on your job.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: Sure. Oh, shoot! That's Tenma and Kamishiro, right? Also known as the weirdos among the second years because they really stand out, and not in a good way...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahahaha! What do you think of that idea?
Go ahead and laud my greatness, I don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you really need to look so smug about it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe, it's a unique idea for sure.
And then if we add my robots and drones into the mixture...hm?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Excuse me, Kamishiro. I'm the hall monitor on duty today. That's quite a large bag you have over there. May I ask what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You mean this? Hehe... Don't worry.
I won't be using it in school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm not asking whether you'll be using it or not...
I'd like to know what's inside.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Whoa. She dares to confront someone so dubious-looking directly to his face? This first year's got some guts!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really... Even if you may regret it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If it's really that bad, I can't possibly allow you to bring it into school, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you're absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This bag contains the tools needed to maintain something she owns.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're from class B, right?
Is he telling the truth?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes... I asked him to bring it along.
I really needed it today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, in that case.
Just this once, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll have to confiscate it the next time I see it.
Consider yourself warned.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll take that warning to heart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Rui actually listened?!
This first year is going places!)

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line:
Sheesh! I was so nervous!
You're amazing, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, what'd I do?

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: It's scary enough to talk to the upperclassmen, but you even managed to give him such a clear warning!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: I'm so glad you're one of the hall monitors, An.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: You kept saying it was out of character for you, but I think you're cut out for this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, whatever. Flattery will get you nowhere with me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, gate's closed.
Let's return to our classrooms too.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Someone's coming.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? But the gate's already closed... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hup!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Are you both late too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course not. And jumping over the gate like that is really dangerous!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I won't get hurt over something like that♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I meant it's dangerous for the other people around! And anyway, you're late. Too bad, you would've made it in time if you were just a little earlier.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? I think I'm pretty early already, for someone who usually comes to school at lunchtime?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well... That's true, too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You see?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then since you're here early for a change, be sure to attend all the classes, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, ma'am!
Oh, by the way, wanna have lunch together later?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: School just started and you're already thinking of lunch?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why does it matter?
Let's have lunch on the rooftop today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Fine, fine. Doesn't look like I have a choice, anyway.
Come on, let's go to our classroom!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I got you a can of juice, Kohane.
Thought you might be thirsty.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Shall we raise a toast?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To us! We did a great job at the event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've gotten used to performing in public, huh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were rocking it today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. You were tuning in to the audience, making eye contact, clapping your hands, adding little things like that to your routine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was really good!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... I was just copying what you normally do. I'm glad it paid off!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll try to stick to this style from now on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got this, girl!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this is completely unrelated but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's something I've been wanting to ask you for a while now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... I was wondering where you shop for clothes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Clothes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just that I never know what to wear for our gigs...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You don't need to dress up in anything special.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I know but...
I'd like to wear something similar in style to what you do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And what's my style?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Things like the cool jacket you always wear or oversized hoodies, and the like...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We often sing together, so having outfits that vibe together could boost our group's look.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally agree.
We dress casually but those are still our stage getups.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to go to some cool-looking clothing stores, but I always get too intimidated.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why? You don't like shopping for clothes alone?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's partly it too, I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's more that I feel out of place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's a noob when it comes to street fashion.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess the rich girls from Miya Academy wouldn't normally wear that sort of stuff.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Won't your parents have any objections if you start dressing like I do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why would they?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Some old folks think that's how bad kids dress.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, no, mine aren't like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're always supportive of my choices.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. They sound nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess people who keep a pet snake aren't the snooty type with rigid ideas of what's proper.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, then. I'll take you along to my favorite clothing stores next time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: One of them's in the mall, actually, so you should be fine shopping there on your own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's another with a really nice owner, great range of cool clothes and affordable prices, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What's the catch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito works there part-time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that...no good?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, how to explain it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyhow, if it doesn't bother you, we can drop by there together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sounds good!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ladies and gents, or should I say—guinea pigs! Get ready to sample and review Weekend Garage's experimental new addition to the menu!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let me help you set the tables.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane! Can you bring over plates from over there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're doing us a big favor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's nothing, really.
We owe you for letting us hang out here all the time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what's new on the menu?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Seafood curry. It's still simmering away.
Give it ten minutes and it'll be ready.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yay! I'm sure it'll be yummy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Curry, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: With seafood...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's the matter? You two sure don't look thrilled...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right, how could I forget. Akito doesn't like carrots...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No need to bring that up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? You don't like carrots, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! What are you, three years old?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You got a problem?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You're one to talk, An.
You still refuse to eat tomatoes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: DAAAD! Don't tell on me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who's the kid now, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm perfectly fine with ketchup!
And if I really had to, I'd eat a tomato, I just don't like them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it the grassy smell that bothers you about them?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's exactly it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And why are you looking so amused, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I'd never have guessed you were a picky eater. And carrots, of all things...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you can eat anything? Then why did you make that face when they said what the food was gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because of the seafood. I don't really eat squid.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What, you don't like squid?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The texture bothers me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmph. I guess you don't like octopus either then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, octopus is fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why? They're both rubbery!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Squid's flat and slimy, but octopus has suckers and actual flavor.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see your point! The firm texture of the suckers is really nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you have any foods you dislike, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Well... I can't really eat pickles.
I like the taste but somehow they make me a bit nauseous.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know that could happen.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The food's ready, kids!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Mmm, smells nice!
Oh, and it even comes with salad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hold on, dad.
Why'd you put tomatoes in the salad?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: To make it more visually appealing, that's why. Don't be so up in arms about it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Urgh... It's loaded with carrots!
Did you do that just to take a dig at me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't even need to put any carrots at all in a SEAFOOD curry!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha, that's also to add some more color to the dish.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't buy that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh... Dad, you're literally making me see red...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, An? You can give me your tomatoes if you want.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll eat them for me? You're my savior, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, let's do a trade. You can dump the squid from your curry on my plate. In return, can you dispose of this cursed vegetable for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. Deal.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I got myself a bunch of tough customers...
At least finish all the food and rate it for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're gonna get clean plates back, dad! Let's dig in!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here's your coffee!

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Hey, is that girl singing right now your new partner?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, she is. Her name's Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line:
Sweet.
She's got a great voice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And also...
In-Store Music Venue

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Customer B
rows.Line:
That was really good!
Can you do one more for us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?!
A-As in an encore?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Okay, I'll sing one more song!

rows.Speaker: Customer B
rows.Line: Now we're talking!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's gotten used to the stage lately and gained a lot of courage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She can now take impromptu requests and even sing along with musicians who jump in without warning!

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line: You're really happy about your partner's progress, eh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course I am! Ah...
Welcome to the shop! Feel free to take the window seat.

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line:
An, can I have my usual?
Make it two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Two coffee blends, got it!
By the way, I saw your live show the other day. It was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line: Really? Thanks for that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to your next one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, good to see you today too.
I heard one of your group members got hurt. Is everything okay now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oops, I'll clear the dishes here for you.
Your performance the other day was so entertaining! Thanks for that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hi, Kohane!
You sang really well today, as usual!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you're just amazing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You were chatting with each individual customer while doing your work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, it's nothing fantastic at all.
You're the amazing one here. I saw the audience asking for an encore!

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line:
Yup, you really are amazing!
I mean, An was the one who approached you and asked to be partners, right?

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: So many people around here have been trying to team up with An, but she never accepted any of their offers.

rows.Speaker: Customer E
rows.Line:
Yeah, and that's why you're amazing.
How'd you manage to win An over?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? I-I didn't do anything to win...
I mean, um...

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line:
Hey, I know!
Why don't you sing with my group instead?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: You sing so well, and if you join my group, An may come sing together with us, too...

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: So, please! Join my group!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Well, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough!
You're putting her on the spot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's MY partner, and I'm not letting her go anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I may have to ban you from the shop if you keep cajoling her like this. Remember that.

rows.Speaker: Customer E
rows.Line: Oh dear... I have no choice but to back down, then.

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: See, you must be really amazing for An to defend you like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for your compliment!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Kohane.
They weren't trying to be mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, thank you for saying that about me.
I'll do my very best to live up to your expectations!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on, you don't have to stress yourself about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's more important for you to decide on what's best for yourself, instead of thinking about what I want, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's the Kohane I want to sing with.
So let's do our best together, alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Please continue to lend me your support, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You bet I will!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So this is the new and improved Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe! I'm so happy I can be here with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Visiting a theme park when we're already in high school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We invited them, you know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While Tsukasa did give us the tickets, I'm surprised you agreed to come along.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Were you thinking of evening out the numbers?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Who cares about that.
I just wanted to escape from Ena's noisy demands of taking pictures for her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome, Aoyagi, thank you for inviting us here today. Let's have fun together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito aside, I'm really happy to be here with you, Kohane! This is my first time, so can you show me around?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? You've never visited Phoenix Wonderland before?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup. Well, at least since they renovated it.
I live nearby but haven't had the chance yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's my first time here too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya... You've never visited this place before?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. So if you don't mind, please show me around too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd be happy to!
The truth is, I'm quite familiar with Phoenix Wonderland myself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I visited every week when I was little.
I even bought the annual pass in middle school and visited every day to take pictures.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Every day? You're like a regular, then.
Any must-visit attractions here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I highly recommend the Phoenix Coaster!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like a big one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, you're not into thrill rides, right?
I remember you're afraid of heights.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can take it if it's a low-lying thrill ride...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no such thing as a low-lying roller coaster...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... That ride may be a little too much for you then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phoenix Coaster used to be a ride that even little children could enjoy, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's recently been upgraded into the Neo Phoenix Coaster and climbs to an incredible height immediately after setting off.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's really exciting when it suddenly drops all the way down from that climb, but that might be too scary for someone who's afraid of heights.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I may not... No. I absolutely can't take that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, there's no need to force yourself to try something you don't like. Any other recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, for attractions that don't go very high, we can try the go-karts or coffee cup ride.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the carousel here is a lot of fun, too! It lights up with beautiful illuminations at night. It would be nice to ride the carousel after dark.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Also, also!
We have to go to Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wonder Stage? To see a show?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! The shows performed there are really exciting! I really hope we can watch it together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So let's first check what time the show starts, then visit the other attractions while we wait, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Dad and I studied how to go around the attractions here without having to wait too long, so I remember them all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think we can definitely do all the rides we want!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You weren't joking when you said you knew this place well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This isn't even regular-level. It's nerd-level already. And you're being a lot more assertive than usual.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll leave it to you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can count on me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Kohane looks really happy.
Akito and Toya don't seem too particularly upset about the situation, either...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I would never have dreamed the four of us would come to a theme park together one day. It may be a good chance to get to know each other better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And the more we get to know each other better like this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, stop spacing out and let's go already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apparently, we should try all the recommended rides. If so, we'll have to hurry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe we'll become the greatest team one day too, like dad and his friends were!)
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Rin and Len really helped turn that into a good practice session.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and we've got a goal to work towards.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In order to catch up to you guys, I'll do everything I can for the outdoor gig!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
If you're this determined, I'm sure it'll be fine.
You'll do great at our next show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I are this way, so we'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. See ya.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
Thanks for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, no.
I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You know, I...
I was scared of telling you how I felt.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm glad I did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So again, thanks for everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Same here, An! Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm glad we could talk, but now I've gotta get back to the cafe. See you tomorrow, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! See you at practice!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad, I'm home!
You're getting ready to open, right? Let me help.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, did you work things out with your friend?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We're all good now!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um...
Say, Dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I was wondering...
Did that ever happen to you too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know... Falling out with someone on your team?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure. It wasn't just disagreements here and there either. We had full-on shouting matches all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What, seriously?
That doesn't seem like you...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It was the worst between me and our best singer.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We kept winding each other up over dumb stuff like our tastes for fashion or food...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: To be honest, none of us in the group meshed that well. We all thought of each other as people we'd never get along with.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you kept making music together...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. Music and singing were what brought us together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So you all had the same taste in music?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Not really. We were always arguing about music too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But when it came to music, it was different.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Normally, no one ever gave in. But somehow, when we had different opinions about making music, we'd compromise.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We all had a lot of respect for each other as musicians. That was how we managed to stay together as a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. In your case, being partners didn't equal being friends.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. I wish we could've been friends too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You feel like you have to protect her...
“Look after” her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I want you to believe in us too!
Because I really believe in you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want nothing more than to keep singing with you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I get what you're saying, Dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Ah, good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But why mention all this now?
You never talked about this stuff before...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Because I knew that you'd understand now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Give it your best, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane, I may still be lacking as a partner...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I promise that I'll become your partner in every sense of the word!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
G-Good morning.
Is An here?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah.
An, your friend's here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, you're already here?
Is it that late?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, um... Before we start practice in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh! You want to do some warm-ups?
In that case, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a favor to ask, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A favor...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to try singing with you. Um, without you holding back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're always doing what you can to help me keep up, but if we keep doing that, I feel like I'll never actually grow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've been practicing a lot lately. I even started doing solo performances on the street and I think I've improved a little.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to test myself.
By singing with you as best I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three!
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's struggling to keep up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to test myself.
By singing with you as best I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm not gonna go easy on her!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She needs to know I recognize her as a singer that's on the same level as me!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you're so amazing. I couldn't keep up at all. I guess I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you're gonna be just as amazing too, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll definitely catch up to you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know you will...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh, I can't believe I was so narcissistic and thought you needed my protection!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told you earlier that I kept thinking I had to look after you until Akito pointed out to me that it was unfair, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was because it felt good having you rely on me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you keep proving to me, like just now, that you don't need any of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're strong enough to get back up and try again without my help after you stumble or even fall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I believe in you, so I'm going to sing as best I can too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It took me way too long to notice that.
I was so blind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
From now on, I'll just be leading you.
Not some selfish mentor, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's give it our best, partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
We're in this together!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What's up, Dad?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Not to interrupt your lovely chat, but weren't you going somewhere today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Gasp! Wait, no!
We're gonna be late!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We've gotta hurry or the guys will get mad over making them wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let me just grab this and we're good to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
By the way, Kohane!
I've got a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't we sing that song again in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: With everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! I'm up for that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright then!
Let's go, partner!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'm done wiping the tables. What's next...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I wonder if Kohane and Toya are okay.
I hope they can talk it out with their parents...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Well, it probably went okay for Kohane,
but I'm worried about Toya...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An... Hey, you there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! Let's see, what was next...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Have you checked the tableware yet?
One table was low on sugar, I think...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! That!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sigh... Are you really that worried about those two?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... You can tell?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's all over your face.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
But they're your friends.
Of course you'd be worried.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Say, dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just if... What if we had a serious disagreement about what I wanted to do with my life? What would you do?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Why are you even asking? Do you really think anything I say will stop you from pursuing what you've decided to do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... I guess...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And I've lived my whole life staying true to my passion so...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It'd be hypocritical of me to try to put my own views on a pedestal and stop you from chasing your own goals.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you've always been supportive of the things I want to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I didn't realize how lucky I was... I feel silly for telling the others to just talk it out with their parents or invite their parents to our gig...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wow...! In retrospect, everything I said feels really thoughtless...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry... Are you closed already?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We were just changing over to the bar menu. I can't take any orders right now, but you're welcome to come in for a chat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Go talk to your friend, An.
You're too spacey to be helpful now anyway.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... Thanks, dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, what's up...?
I thought you were going straight home today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was but... I wanted to come up with a strategy first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You see, I thought that instead of just inviting my parents to an event, I should assure them first that live houses aren't sketchy or dangerous places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know, I felt nervous walking around Vivid Street when I first came here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'd rather have my parents feel some sort of wonder or excitement about where we're going instead of just flatly labeling it a scary place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally agree!
Do you have something in mind?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, I thought that maybe this would work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! You made a photobook!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I gathered fliers and pamphlets from the events we took part in for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You even wrote notes about each venue!
And about the other groups that were there too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, this is awesome! This is definitely gonna make your parents see what we do from your perspective!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank goodness. I'm glad you think so!
I'll finish it up and show it to them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Once you put your mind to something,
you stay completely dedicated to it.
I think that's really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you actually gave me the idea to make a photobook.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, I did?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You said, Have them see it for themselves.
And I might've come up with the same idea...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I would've been too worried about it backfiring on me if I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But back then, you also said,
A picture is worth a thousand words.
Then I knew this was the best thing to do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... Thank you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I was just throwing ideas around, you know?
You're giving me too much credit!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright! How about this?
I'll help you with your photobook.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Absolutely! Your future as a member of our team hinges on it, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here we go again...
An's back to her usual self.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Looks like I'll have to give her the rest of the day off.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Wow... She's modulating her voice beautifully!
And the high notes she's been practicing
seem totally fine now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't let her just leave me behind!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whew... Great work today, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You too, An. That was a good session!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've pretty much mastered those high notes you were having trouble with the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe... I just followed your advice.
I also practiced a lot at home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, my dad walked in on me when I was practicing in my room too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought he was going to complain about the noise, but he asked me to sing more so he could record me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha! Oh, you're dad...
He just loves you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It did make me feel really happy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But your dad's like that too.
I can really tell just by your interactions
that you mean everything to him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? I mean, I'm grateful that he respects my decisions and lets me do what I really want...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice, isn't it?
Our families supporting our choices...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Family, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Say, Kohane. You got some time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. Did you want to go to Weekend Garage?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um, nah. Let's stay here...
I wanna talk more about family stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Family stuff?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We've gotten to know each other pretty well, but there's still a lot of other stuff we haven't talked about yet, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's talk more about family stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure, I'm curious too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see your dad all the time, but only heard you talk about your mom a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, we can start with her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great! Umm... She's a teacher, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't know if it's because of her job, but she's always pestered me about studying harder and says that knowledge is always worth having.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that it's good to know a lot of stuff about a wide range of subjects...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But how's anything about Edo or the Tokugawa Shogunate gonna help me? I feel like it's her fault that I ended up hating studying.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess she was pretty tough on you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. On the other hand, sometimes I feel like asking her if she really paid attention during home ec since she likes learning so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She says she always follows a recipe, but she usually ends up using too much seasoning or forgets to adjust the burner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right. Cooking isn't her strong suit.
And you cook from time to time too, no?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. And I'll try to save some of mom's dishes from becoming complete failures when I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What about you, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I think my mom's a pretty good cook.
She even used to bake cakes fairly often.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's awesome!
But she doesn't make them anymore?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No. She's not just a homemaker anymore after taking up a part-time job when I started junior high.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She said I was grown-up enough for her not to worry about leaving me at home alone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, and is she cool with snakes too?
You've had yours for a long time, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha, well... Not exactly.
She'd be happier with a dog or a cat...
You know, more normal pets...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But she's also a softie and has a hard time saying no to my dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is. Oh, this other time, when dad wanted to get a new camera...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for sticking around and telling me about your mom and dad! I really enjoyed your stories!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for telling me about your mom too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Next time we should ask Shinonome and Aoyagi.
Neither of us have any siblings so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! But I have a feeling Akito won't be very chatty.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I've gotta get back to the cafe to help out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! See you tomorrow, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer A
rows.Line: Oh, it's An! Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer B
rows.Line: Were you doing a show on Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I was just practicing with a teammate in the park today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But it's unusual for you to come in through the front door during business hours. Why didn't you go through the back this time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... Not really sure but...
I guess I just felt like it today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll go grab an apron!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, one more thing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Welcome home.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, dad...!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting pretty late.
Maybe we should call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sounds good. We can practice later on our own too since there aren't any events today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Just make sure to at least go over what came up during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Got it! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome looks like he's back to being his old self...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I was really worried about what would happen, but I'm glad everything worked out.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? There's a ton of people here...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe an event just ended?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Arata with another awesome performance!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, he really might be the one that surpasses RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Ain't that the truth! He's gotta be the closest to actually doing it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everybody's been talking about Tono lately, haven't they?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They have.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You can't deny that he's good. Us four together were just barely able to hold our own against him.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's like...
How do I put it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Put what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What those other people were talking about. How Arata's the closest one to surpassing RAD WEEKEND, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's good, but what I saw during his performance didn't feel like it could reach the level of that legendary night...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even though he's that good...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's also the part of me that doesn't want him to surpass us and be the first to do it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I believe that RAD WEEKEND was as great as it was because so many people were involved in making it happen, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're right. You even mentioned a little about RAD WEEKEND the first time you invited me to sing with you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told my dad that I wanted to organize an event just like his. I still remember his response.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He said, This event was only possible because of all the people I'd met in this town who love music so much. There's no way I could have done this on my own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It made me want to start meeting those kinds of people. My dream is to organize the greatest event in history with them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! That's why I spent so much looking for a partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You really startled me that time too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm so glad I had the courage to say yes to you then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now we're both trying to make a really cool dream come true!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...! I can't thank you enough for becoming my partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wha...! A-An, please don't throw yourself at me like that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to put on an event that's bigger than RAD WEEKEND with Kohane!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But that also makes me wonder...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (How does Arata plan on doing that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An! That reminds me...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've been meaning to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Since we're trying to make the same dream a reality, I was hoping that you and Shinonome could tell me more about that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to hear more about how RAD WEEKEND really was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
But can I really do it justice...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was sort of like... When the four of us battled against Arata during that event, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, sort of...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As the night went on, one performer after another got up on stage and kept getting the crowd more and more pumped!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everybody wanted to sing! Everybody wanted to hear more! The sky was the limit that night!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone there was so excited and couldn't wait to see what would happen next.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's something you can't really achieve by any normal means. That might be the best way to describe RAD WEEKEND... How's that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha... Maybe that was a little too abstract. I hope you sort of got what I was trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I understand! I think I have a good idea of what you were trying to say!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, we're nowhere near the level we need to be at as a team to surpass that night. That's why we just gotta keep getting better and better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll keep doing everything I can as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD, and as your partner, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane! I'll be counting on you!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So we're deciding on which events we'll be entering in today, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. The problem is that we've been invited by a bunch of people...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: These events give us experience and help us grow, but doing all of them is a little much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's why I came up with this idea! Here, take a look at these!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Are these all event flyers?
How many are there?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A lot of people working at the live houses around here come to ask if they can post these to advertise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on... Aren't these all battle events?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! Those are the only ones I chose!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that have something to do with this idea of yours...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, you got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were originally two separate pairs, right? We really only became a foursome just recently if you think about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why I want us to do as many events as possible as a complete team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
But why just battles?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To keep honing our skills!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Battle events have winners and losers, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And no one participates in these unless they feel like they can win!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone's at each other's throats thinking that they'll be the ones that get the crowd going the most.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! That's why I think we'll get better the fastest by doing these events!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I thought it'd be nice to find a singing style that suits us best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A singing style?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. For the longest time, I sang in shows and events on my own while I was looking for a partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know a lot about solo artists and performers, but not much about teams...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like EVER from STAY GOLDEN. I knew of them, but I didn't know anything about their songs or that they'd be in the same event as us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There wasn't much we could do about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: EVER performs at live houses outside of Vivid Street from what I heard too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Some teams even play at only one live house.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's what I'm talking about! There's probably still a bunch of other really good teams out there that we don't know about yet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want us to find them, meet them and battle against them! We might even learn about what we might be missing or need to do as a team!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that's what you meant by us finding a singing style, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree with An. We might learn quite a bit by seeing how other teams sing and perform together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? What do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially since it'll help us grow both as a team and individually at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a pretty good idea all things considered.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All things considered?
What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now, with An's idea in mind, let's get back to what we were talking about...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right, which events should we pick...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We'll have to find the ones that best suit us first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's do this!
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that's about how everything goes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! I guess we should hammer out the trickier parts of the dance routine next.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You learn quick, but that might just also mean I'm a good teacher.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously? That's all I get for agreeing to help you after just being thrown in like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I apologize, Shiraishi.
But I really appreciate you doing this for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's okay, don't worry! I wasn't just about to let you guys flail around like fish out of water...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I was surprised by how Kamishiro's directing everything for this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It all started with me replacing Tsukasa and him coming here to see if everything was okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He ended up agreeing to help so that the bride's surprise would actually happen during the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I didn't know.
He's a pretty good guy, isn't he?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Weddings are a huge deal too, so I get how he wants everything to go well! Let's give it our best shot too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't wait for everything to start. You're supposed to propose to the bride, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I wasn't sure what to do when I was picked, but I think everything will be fine now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm still not really sure about all that.
You've got a guy playing basketball and another doing origami...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The other guys that are proposing to the bride.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
What do those have to do with proposing to the bride?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think there's nothing to worry about. That's all a part of the act too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is pretty cool, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kamishiro just got here a little while ago, right? Then he just took over, decided what to do and started getting everything set up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When the time comes for us to put on an event, we'll probably be doing the same sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, ours is gonna be just about music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: True. However, I do think that RAD WEEKEND was a once-in-a-lifetime event like this for my dad too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, it was the culmination of everything he'd been doing as a musician.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
And this experience will be invaluable to us as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Hehe. This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, someone's messaging me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our phones were ringing too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That means... Yeah, it's Kohane!
She sent us all something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She says she's by my place and wondering if we can gather later for practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Later tonight, sure, but not now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
*Sigh*... I wish Kohane could be here too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even if she hurried over, she probably won't make it in time for the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, who'd just up and go after being told something like that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you came, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because you said it was an emergency...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. I don't want her to panic or anything... I'll try explaining what's up and have her wait at my place then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At least she'll have somewhere to hang around, but can you really explain what we've been roped into?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you talking about? That's easy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You two, stand over there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll stand... Here.
Now, smile as best you can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! Wait, hold on...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Say cheese!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! I got all three of us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, a picture would be much simpler than telling her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just gotta attach our pic and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Some stuff happened and we were asked to be in a flash mob for a wedding.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Once we're done, we'll head right over. Just sit tight.> Send...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's almost time too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Let's make this the best wedding ever!
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
I'm glad that our surprise went over so well too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. And thank you again, Shiraishi, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No prob.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I need to get back to Weekend Garage to see Kohane. What are you two gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? That voice... Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I decided to hurry over.
That was so great, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you know where we were, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That photo you sent me actually sort of told me. I took a guess and went for it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. Thanks for coming, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I wish you got here sooner. The ceremony and our surprise performance are all done now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Everybody got so pumped up too.
I really wanted you to see it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I still got to see part of it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it seemed okay for outsiders to take pictures, so I decided to take some myself. They're all in this folder. See...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, let's see... Wait, you took 200 pictures?! How'd you take so many?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I used burst mode for some of them, so I ended up taking quite a few.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I took wide shots, close-ups and all sorts of other photos too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's incredible.
It's not like our show was that long either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hey, Kohane...
Can I see more of your pics?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, but the sun might've made some of them too dark because of where I was standing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? All of them look good as far as I can tell!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like this one. You can tell how much fun the dancers are having and even how hard they're dancing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, check this out...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the proposal scene...
That's how I looked during that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Lemme see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good expression!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Akito's got a good look on his face in this one! It's like when he's trying to act like a nice guy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I got some of you too, An. You really looked like you were having a lot of fun out there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, this was when we started dancing with the people passing by!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You did what? I can't imagine how they felt when you did that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Look! They're having tons of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, also... I'd like you to see this one too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, wow! It's the bride and the groom!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. They looked so happy together.
I couldn't resist taking this one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Their expressions are priceless!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. So this is how they looked during that moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we didn't get a chance to see them since we were too busy singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So how do you feel, Toya?
This was what you and Kamishiro were hoping for, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad to see this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sigh*... It all just blew by like a storm. It came and went, and it's all over now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I feel satisfied... Like I actually did something today, you know...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even though I joined in at the last minute. Imagine what it'll be like when it's our turn to do something like this. Who knows what that'll feel like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No idea, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll know when it happens, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It might be way in the future, but that's why we gotta keep getting better!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Until that day comes when it is our turn...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright! I'm all fired up now. How does getting some practice in sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Azusawa was asking if we had time to do that later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. But I'm sure you're all tired after doing that performance...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I think we all still want to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Also, there's no point in wasting time moving somewhere else. Wanna head over to SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We gotta keep trying! The four of us are definitely gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND together!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, finally. Over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I forgot to mention this during school, but thanks for helping me out yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was about us as a team, so it's fine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So have you spoken to Azusawa about us entering into STAY GOLDEN again?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not yet because I plan on telling her in person. We can bring it up with her once she gets here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But STAY GOLDEN. It's already that time of year again, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys sort of just dropped it on me yesterday, but I am starting to think it's a good opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
See?
This sort of thing's also what you and Kohane are good at, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You surprised us once already so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Ohh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have the resolve.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I won't run away anymore!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're the Vivids! Did everyone enjoy the show?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We may be new at this, but one day we're going to throw an event that'll surpass even RAD WEEKEND! We hope you'll be there to support us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that time...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt the same way that time too, but Azusawa really has been improving at an astonishing rate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and we're not about to just let her leave us behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I've been here this whole time thinking I know so much about Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we don't have a choice since that's how she feels.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, didn't you say that you talked to MEIKO about this before coming to us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did that go?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... She said Kohane the kind of person that likes to see the good in others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that she should believe in the good within herself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The good within yourself, huh? If someone told me that, I probably wouldn't know where to start...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, the good you see in others is sort of what you're missing yourself, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It might be easier to think about it the other way around like, Why can't I do what that other guy can?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Yeah, this is a tough one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we come up with as many good things as we can about her and tell her about them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We can make it easier for Kohane to see the good in her if we just tell her about just how awesome she is!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I understand the general idea of what you're trying to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Okay, how about...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, she's obviously the best partner ever! Second, she's like this adorable little animal that becomes a super cool singer when she gets up on stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it's so cute how she nibbles on her food or leaves the things she likes most for last! Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why are you making that face?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You started with stuff that could be said about anyone and ended by just saying how cute she is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may want to be more objective and describe her using a more diverse vocabulary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... More objective, and a diverse vocabulary...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, why don't you guys try telling her instead of me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it ever comes up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, she's your teammate too.
Help her out, alright?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, if it ever comes up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, how would you feel if we just started ranting and raving about what we like about you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How would I feel...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In Azusawa's case, she may feel happy for a moment but also startled or surprised at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, there's no one out there that would just take random compliments seriously.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I guess that means kicking butt at STAY GOLDEN's the best way to go then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, like we planned. Talk about STAY GOLDEN.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, this is an event I want to get back at too...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I have to support my partner in whatever ways I can! Especially now!)
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're gonna help us with practice, right, Miku? You won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I know I won't.
By the way, where's Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's busy taking care of animals for her committee, so she's gonna be late.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. We have some time until she gets here I suppose.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, I almost forgot...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We did another STAY GOLDEN and kicked its butt like I said we would!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wish you were there to see it! Especially how Kohane did!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she was just something else. So good that I almost forgot to sing my own part!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That must've been incredible.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to think Kohane feels a lot better about herself after what she pulled off...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I was finally able to actually support her as her partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But there's a part of me that keeps saying that I would've been able to do this sooner if I had my priorities straight, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was probably going to be a long process after she took up street music and met all of you guys, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane began singing because of you, An, correct?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means what she knows about your world is entirely based on what you know, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What I know equals what she knows...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Especially what it means to sing well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your singing ability was her starting point. Thus, I thought that it would be a long process for her no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As a result, even though she kept improving, she wasn't able to feel confident about herself until now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's why her idea of what counts as good felt so off sometimes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. For example, what we practice each day. Currently, Azusawa works on a list of things we prepared for her...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's mostly just about fundamentals, but that workload also isn't something your average novice can handle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right... But she was doing all sorts of stuff even before you guys set that up for her, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. She seemed eager to do more, so we slowly gave her more and more things to work on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does she even know how heavy her workload actually is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's true. Conversely, she may be under the impression that she's not doing enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It also doesn't help that she's seen Akito and I handle even heavier loads.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So Miku was right. Kohane thinks this is normal because of us...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Correct.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She just kept getting better and better, and just brushed off what we practiced like it was nothing so I never really thought about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But she really thinks this is just how things are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that make her some kind of glee monster?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you call her something a little nicer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But someone told her that she needs to commit and have more confidence in herself, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. It'll be better for Kohane if she figured that out on her own, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may've been so desperate to catch up with you guys that she never gave herself a chance to see how she was doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For better or worse, her world, her SEKAI is only about Vivid BAD SQUAD right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It also means that you guys mean that much to her, so I suppose it may not be as closed off as I'm saying it may be...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But in your world, that's not the case, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it's great how she's performing in events and singing all on her own now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wasn't that just about getting more experience and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and I believe that she benefitted in that way as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I think her gaining some independence gave her an opportunity to see your world through her own eyes and not just yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Through her own eyes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just as her meeting you, An, and becoming interested in the street music scene opened doors for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Meeting others will also start opening doors for her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know who this person is, but the advice they gave her might end up being one of the best things that's happened to her, no?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
Yeah, that totally makes sense!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I promised to ask about who that person was, but never really got around to it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, where is she...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She does seem to be running very late. Maybe we should call her...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait... Crap!
She messaged me earlier.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I'm hurrying but it's still gonna take me a while, so please start without me.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then let's do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll tell her that she can take her time and doesn't have to rush.
One day during break
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nothing's been going well lately...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Especially during team practices when my mind gets so caught up in whatever this hazy feeling is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Seriously, what is this thing?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know why I'm feeling this either, but I'm guessing what just happened has something to do with it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This is nothing like her usual self. Did she just figure out how to commit to herself...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't believe it. She changed that much in this little time...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is the real Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad Kohane's finally figured out how to have confidence in herself.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I helped her reach that point...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're still worried about what's gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just listen to what I'm about to say.

rows.Speaker: An
