rows.Line: Let's believe in what An Shiraishi has to say, the girl who absolutely loves the way you, Kohane Azusawa, sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I understand how it's hard for you to believe in yourself, but it's easy for you to believe what I'm saying, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I, An Shiraishi, will always believe in your ability to sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'll believe in you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That's right.
I fulfilled my duties as her partner for once.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I did and also really happy about Kohane being able to show in that event who she really is.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But as amazing as STAY GOLDEN was, my mind's not really in a mood to celebrate.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Times like these...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Haruka's the best person to ask about these things since she's gone through so much with her team... No, groupmates...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But she's probably super busy right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who else can I talk to...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Mizuki's gone today too...
Come to think of it, Mizuki hasn't been to school in a while...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it'd be kinda bad to dump this on someone when they're actually eager to go to school for a change...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So who else...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That leaves Dad, Akito or Toya...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I did already talk to them once about helping Kohane have more confidence in herself.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And there's also...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have more people to talk to than I realized.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll just try asking as many of them as I can about whatever it is that's bothering me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I don't really know how to describe this to someone right now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, let's start with that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll try to learn a little more about this hazy feeling and figure out a way to describe it better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I don't want to ruin all the progress Kohane's made since she really seems to believe in herself now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I still have plenty of time...
I should go buy lunch while I can!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for singing with me, Kohane! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel a lot better now too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I should be thanking you.
It was nice to sing with you like this for a change!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, we have sort of only been moving as a unit lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this might be good to do every now and then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I think I've had my fill of fun for now. I should probably go home and help out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna come with, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I need to do my homework after this, so I'll be heading straight home.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Homework?
That is pretty admirable of you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I usually just do it all in a hurry during breaks or right before class starts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you really shouldn't do that! You need to actually study more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Anyway, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, time to go home...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was hoping to ask you this a little sooner, but how are you doing...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seemed to be busy talking to and singing with Kohane. Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to eavesdrop either...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I should apologize for not noticing you sooner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... How much did you see?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everything from when you asked Kohane about going somewhere far away.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
It would've been pretty awkward to butt in there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right. Not exactly the most opportune moment to interrupt your conversation.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But I'm glad that you seem to feel better now.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<And I feel better as a result too.
Anyway, I'll be going now. See you later.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wait, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I wanted to keep asking her about this, but I guess I'll just have to wait.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's go home.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm home...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, you're home early.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Did you find the answer you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, it's pretty rare to see no customers here...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It is about time to start getting ready to switch to the bar menu.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, could you flip the sign to “Closed” for me? I'd like to get a head start on changing over.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We can even talk about how things are going with you while we get ready.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, help me set the tables.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, about what we talked about...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, that hazy feeling I was having? I think I finally figured out what was causing it.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to be a partner that Kohane can respect and be proud of.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'll have to make sure Kohane stays excited about the way I sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like she took this huge leap forward during STAY GOLDEN, while I just stood by and watched.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I became so worried about her losing interest in me as she climbed higher and higher...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That hazy feeling began welling up inside of me.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry for making you worry so much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Nonsense. You're young, so you should be trying to experience as many different things as you can.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Does this mean you've figured out a way to deal with the way you're feeling?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not exactly, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For now, “I just gotta keep going!”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. Diving in head first.
I like that. It's very you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really appreciate you talking with me about this, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Happy to help, as your father and as your role model.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's right. For now, I just gotta keep going...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I might have to deal with something like this again in the future while I search for an answer...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But for now, this is all I can do.)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Then, I'll see you Sunday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! See you then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. An entire day with Kohane, Haruka and Minori...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (How long's it been since I last saw Minori? The Fan Festival?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I haven't seen Haruka since her birthday. I can't wait!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Hey, An! Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Is your team all done with practice today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just give me a second, Dad, and I'll lend you a hand!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hm? Someone's in a good mood.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm going on a date this Sunday.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A date?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
A... A date?!
A-A-An's going on a date?!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Yeah, hold on! No one's said anything about you seeing anyone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Why are you guys so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Of course we're surprised!
Right, Ken?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hahahah!
What's there to be surprised about?

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: What?! Does that mean you know who she's going out with, Ken?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, yeah.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Just think about it.
She found such a cute girl to be her partner.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: O-Ohh...! That's who she was talking about...!!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
Haha. Now it all makes sense!
Yeah, who else would it be?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aww, you figured it out?
I thought I had you guys going there...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: How would I not? You're my daughter.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Also, what happened to lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Be right there.
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Morning, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I haven't told Akito or Toya yet about us taking Sunday off.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Akito, Toya, morning!
There's something I need to tell you guys. Got a minute?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
Is it about practice today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. No, actually...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm going on a date this Sunday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, with Kohane.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She must be talking about Azusawa.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, have fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, hold on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's important to take breaks every now and then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you guys already know that I'm going with Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, who else would you be talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh, you guys are so boring. Dad and the others included...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What were you expecting us to say...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, An, Toya, Li'l Bro.
Good morning♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Morning. Hey, it's pretty rare to see you here on time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. See, I'm a good student. Anyway, what were you guys just talking about? Whatever it was, it sounded pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
I'm going on a date this Sunday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, with Kohane?
Good for you, An♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, you knew too...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, is there anyone who wouldn't be able to figure that out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That obvious...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All you do is go around telling everyone about “Kohane this” and “Kohane that”, so it can't be that hard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, it just means that everyone knows how close you two are, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we're gonna head back to class.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See you again after school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, see you guys later...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm happy but feel conflicted for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Don't worry so much about it. Come on, let's get back to class.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mhm...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's so nice out!
A perfect day to practice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
What's up? Out and about today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪ I just went and checked out this apparel shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, does this bag mean you got something there? I love this design!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too! Everything this place had was so in right now and really adorable.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Mind if I take a peek at what you got?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, check this out♪ The one with the plastic cover has these gorgeous lace and frill patterns on it. You can really tell the designer put their heart and soul into it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. You must really love it!
It'd be great to see how you look in it, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been a while since I last found a place like this, so I'd love to show you sometime, An.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I even found one in a different color with this really chic design! I bet it'd look great on someone with straight hair like you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't really know much about these kinds of clothes, but if you're willing to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really mean it!
Lemme show this place to you sometime!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but I actually just spent a bunch of money on some new clothes recently...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For your date with Kohane?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I ended up splurging a bit to make sure I had something good to wear, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I totally get it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, how'd it go?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was the best day ever!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's great.
Tell me more! Where'd you guys go and stuff?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd love to stay and talk, but I have to go practice with Kohane and the others soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure thing! Oh, I know. How about I tell you all about it during lunch the next time you come to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All during lunch?
Haha. You must be dying to tell me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll be back soon! I really want to hear more about you too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great, I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wow, it's already been a week since that day too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! The center of the fountain under Phenny's feet! It's like there's something there, but not. Can you see it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Was there a Phenny hiding there this whole time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we make this our hidden Phenny?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ours...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it'll be our special spot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The way she smiled was so priceless.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to be by her side and keep seeing that smile...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I hope I can keep being her partner too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying my best to stay her partner. No, probably even harder than ever...!)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Let's go...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Kohane!
Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, skewers are on the fire!
Now to just wait for them to cook.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope they turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same.
Just don't them burn, alright, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Shut up! I won't!
I'm keeping a close eye on them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll help monitor them as well. It'd be a shame to have put in all that effort and not be rewarded...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, it's very interesting to see how a person cooks can be an expression of their personality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What? Oh, Ms. Kawasaki...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Hello!
Is An here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Kawasaki, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Hey, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Huh? Speaking of what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were just talking about how you've been telling everyone that I modeled for you.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, that! I mean, I got such a cute and gorgeous shot of you! Why wouldn't I want to show it to everyone around town?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: It's visual proof that you're all grown up, An. The little girl we all love so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really appreciate it, but it doesn't make it any less embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Don't say that.
You looked absolutely stunning.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, also! The results from the contest came in, so I'd like to talk with you some more. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure, I think so...
Um, Dad, can I take a quick break...?

rows.Line: Yeah, go for it since it's pretty calm right now. Also, here's the cafe mocha your partner ordered.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's here too, Ms. Kawasaki, so we can talk in the back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you got an award?!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes, I did. Here, this is my entry!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?!
This was when I saved Vivi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I thought you wanted to get a photo of a happy wedding, Ms. Kawasaki?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: You're right. However, I thought this photo best encapsulated the moment when “happiness brings everyone together”.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: The look of sheer relief on your face seeing that Vivi's safe, An... Along with the gentle smiles on Airi and Kohane's faces as they pick the leaves off your dress!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: And the way Shizuku's so subtly keeping you on your feet after you'd lost one of your heels is just so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Your kindness compelled you to act, An, with the groom supporting you and your friends watching over you with warm gazes...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: This photo tells me the relationship these four individuals have is going to keep blossoming into something magnificent.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I think so too...!
This was my first chance to really talk to Airi and Shizuku, but this photo makes it look like we're old friends.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, even though it was pretty much my first time ever meeting them...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a testament to how wonderful you all are as people.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
An, Kohane...
Again, thank you for agreeing to model for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we should be the ones saying that! Thank you for giving us such a fun opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's right! If you ever need us to model again, feel free to ask.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: You really mean that?! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, next time, instead of as models, I'd love to take photos of you two performing as musicians.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, like when we sing during an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes! I heard that you even put on your own event with some friends recently and how it was a big success.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Grr... If only I'd known about that sooner. I would've wrapped up my other job and rushed back...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
We've actually been talking about doing more in the future.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna put on an even better event than last time, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Welcome... Oh, it's you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, is that any way to treat a customer?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Alright, my loyal patron.
What would you like?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Whiskey...is what I want to say, but I'll have a coffee. Hot.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Line: Hi, Uncle Taiga!

rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Line: Hey, I didn't know you guys were here.

rows.Line: We just finished practicing, so we're here to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You guys practice during your days off? Aren't you all hard-working!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we're not little kids anymore.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What are you talking about? Of course you are.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Either way, I definitely think you guys have more moxie than most people around here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't let him fool you, Kohane.
That's just his way of pulling one over on you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm serious.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Some stuff came up and I ended up telling everyone about how I ran away when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Oh, that story...?!
You really had the entire town in a panic that time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...
So, when I started looking back on what happened...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: This is where we met Ken. Things weren't easy back then since he and Taiga didn't really get along at first...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But everyone around town thought that they were good rivals and helped stop them from fighting. As a result, they began to understand each other better.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Without them, we probably wouldn't be a team right now...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi said that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. That really stuck out in my mind and kinda want to hear more about what you guys were like back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd like to know as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're a team, so the possibility of us having strong disagreements isn't zero.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd like to hear too.
Did you have conflicting ideas regarding your team's music?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, we definitely had our fair share of disagreements when it came to how to interpret our music, the way we sang and whatnot...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Pretty silly things in retrospect.
Also, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And yeah... A lot of our disagreements and fights were about the dumbest things...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: However, back then, we weren't willing to bend on some things because of our convictions.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Our convictions, huh...?
I'm still not sure how to feel about that Hawaiian shirt of yours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hawaiian shirt?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, he wore this unbelievably lame Hawaiian shirt one time to this really important event...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Whoa, hold on. How many times do I have to tell you? That wasn't my idea... It was a gift from some people who helped me out, so I had no choice.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The plan was to wear it during a big event and have them see me wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
And you're just as guilty.
I still clearly remember how you wore these pathetic-looking socks that day.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, I told you on more than one occasion that those were a part of my lucky outfit...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Dad, you had a lucky outfit?
What kind of socks were they?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, they were the kind of pair with a little design stitched into each sock.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They had these cute, little glasses of cream soda embroidered into them, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cream soda?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That's right. Actually, they were...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Whoa, stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken seems awfully flustered...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now this is something we don't get to see every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cream soda embroidery...? Wait, I've heard that before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember now...!
Mom gave them to you for your birthday!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
An, how...?
That happened before we got married.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I heard from Mom when I was little. We went out shopping together to get you a birthday present...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Before we were married, I gave your father socks this one time for his birthday.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Socks? Why?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: He takes very good care of all the various outfits he wears during shows, including his flashy necklaces and such...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: But he has a habit of losing individual socks because he doesn't show the same respect for them.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: And he always ends up tossing the other from the pair, claiming that he can't wear them unless he has the matching set.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: What?! Those poor socks!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Isn't it a shame? Which is why I figured that he'd take better care of them if he received a pair as a birthday present.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Your father was in love with the cream soda this cafe in the neighborhood made, so I decided to get a pair with some glasses of them embroidered in.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Daddy likes cream soda?
I thought he only drank really bitter coffee.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: That's true now, but he couldn't get enough of sweets and sugary drinks back then.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Really? And did he take good care of those cream soda socks you gave him?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, very!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, Dad?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's such a beautiful story.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hahaha! But they still look terrible on you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I mean, you're so superstitious that you felt compelled to wear the socks that your then girlfriend got for you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Quiet, you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Line: But whenever she sang, she shined brighter than anyone else and made the stage feel really far away despite it usually being right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've seen Aunt Nagi be everything from really nice to really funny...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Aunt Nagi at her coolest became the person I came to really admire. She's the one who I placed on a pedestal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The person you really admire?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
That's sort of what it comes down to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been wanting to surpass RAD WEEKEND for the longest time, but I'd never thought about becoming better than Aunt Nagi until now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can see why.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She's your role model.
It only seems natural for you to want her to outshine everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it might be time for me to grow out of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still have a long ways to go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I want to keep singing alongside Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I want to put on the best event ever and surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to stop putting Aunt Nagi on such a high pedestal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem to have a much clearer sense of what you want to do now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That's because you were willing to listen, Miku.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I realized that there's a huge difference between thinking and brooding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that it's important to brood sometimes, but I always seem to get really lost or more confused.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed quite lost that time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was. I guess it just isn't good for me to dwell on an idea for too long...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I'm thinking about taking action instead! I know that I'll have to sit down to think about things sometimes, but I wanna spend more of that time working on my singing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree. That suits you much better, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I guess I might start to brood over things down the line, but I'll just do what I can when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see no problem with that.
I take it as a sign that you're mentally ready for such a moment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. Alright, I'm gonna stick with that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've grown so much, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I have?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I really like where you're at right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Stop, Miku, you're making me blush.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, An, you still plan on practicing on your own for a bit, right? Mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! Here we go!

rows.Line: Oh, mind if I keep going to see what's inside?

rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, totally!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: And in my case, you were a huge help during the Sports Festival.

rows.Line: What? But we were the ones who asked you to direct for the cheer squad, so I feel like we owe you a lot more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:

Would you mind taking this present off our hands?

rows.Line:

Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

It's not very big, but it feels pretty heavy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's for you to find out when you open it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya said that you'd all be celebrating as a team, so why not open it then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was wondering why they knew when my birthday was, but it was Toya who told them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi, we look forward to working with you as we safely carry out tests and experiments in the future.

rows.Line: We?

rows.Line: Hehehe. Now then...

rows.Line: It can't be easy being a hall monitor having someone like him around.

rows.Line: If you genuinely feel that way, you could try stopping him.

rows.Line: My life would be so much easier if I could!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! You're so quick to admit it!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <After all those warnings we gave you before coming here too...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <An, everyone, pardon the intrusion.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome! My dad's still getting the back ready, so it should be okay for you guys to talk.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Really? That's good to hear!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it is. It would've been a shame for us to have to whisper through a happy celebration such as this!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <To be fair, they'll be over in SEKAI later, so why don't we save our best for then?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I mean, we're really just here to see what's going on with this birthday party.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <True! And everyone from around town's supposed to stop by too, right?!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! But there's something I should do before they arrive...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something you should do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Kamishiro and Tenma gave me a birthday present and said that I should open it when we're celebrating as a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That box...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. What do you think's inside?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on... You know, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya & KAITO
rows.Line:
(Ah, of course.)
<(Aha, I see.)>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's open it!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good.
So, here we go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
S-Something just popped out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane Doll
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, An!>
<Happy birthday, An!>

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Is that...?!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line: <A jack-in-the-box...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Looks like it. There was that party popper sound, then all those snacks and that doll jumped out.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane Doll
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, An!>
<Happy birthday, An!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha! That doll looks just like you, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does!
And it's sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Also, this doll's voice...
Isn't it the real Kohane's?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Which means...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu asked me about helping with this little surprise.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She said that Kamishiro was thinking about doing something for An and wanted me to help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But seeing it like this... It's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It is? But I love it!
So thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll have to thank Kamishiro and the others later.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, here are the snacks that flew out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's eat them once the party gets started!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Hello!
Ken, An, we're here to party it up again this year!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Here's some of my homemade pickles!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Hold up! Who brings pickles to a party?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone!

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: And I really love your pickles, so I'm glad you brought them over again this year!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
See?!
This is proof that I understand her the best!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <An's so loved.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. She certainly is.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, everyone! We'll get started once my dad gets back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We'll be here to celebrate as well, albeit discretely.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! Have fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad! Everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. An seems so happy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she does.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Rui & Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We heard that our surprise went over very well! There really is nothing better than a jack-in-the-box when it comes to that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? I have to think they liked it because of the Kohane doll. FYI, I'm the one who designed her! I worked away at it while enduring Ena's endless criticism♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. In any case, we're glad that you enjoyed it so much. Also, the doll's voice can be turned on or off at any time, so you'll be able to hear Azusawa's voice whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you already had a chance to try on the clothes we got you? We chose your present after discussing it at length together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we really did! We sorted through all these clothes that we thought would look great on you and managed to find the ones that made us go, “This!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I really wasn't expecting our final choice to be a one-piece dress.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. We understand that cool and trendy is your style, but I thought that it'd be nice to get you something that you don't wear all that often.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I get that you might be a little embarrassed at first, but we really think you'll look great in it. Please let us know what you think when you do get a chance to try it on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, An!
Hehe. I'm glad you liked our surprise so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, it was really fun to sing happy birthday with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nobody gave me a heads up about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's because I asked them to keep it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? You...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, Shiraishi, happy birthday.
I'm looking forward to what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Especially since this team can't move forward without you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! So let's keep singing together forever and ever, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So many people joined me to celebrate my birthday today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess it's because they all care about me and really want me to succeed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means I have to keep doing my best and make sure I don't disappoint them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, Akito should be...
Oh, hey, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you're here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You said that the track's coming along nicely. Can I hear it? I really want to...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Calm down. Yes, it's coming along, but I've only built its foundation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Its foundation...
So, like the drums and beat...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you can leave coming up with cool ideas to me! I'm sure I'll think of something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Anyway, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally goes with our “Silence & Action” theme!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially the “Silence” part! That was so awesome! It's like it resonated with my entire body!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I did work pretty hard on that part.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also... Hmm... Oh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We might be able to capture “Action” better with the intro by having it start quiet, then explode!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? But it already sort of does that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm saying we can emphasize that more! It starts out quiet as it is, right? I think we can really make it pop after building up all that anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I... Wait, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What? You know exactly what I mean.
Start quiet and end with a bang!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So... How exactly do you want to make that happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How exactly...?
Hmm... Can't we think of that together?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What in the world are you two talking about? Something about a quiet explosion...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kotaro! Were you listening to our conversation just now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I only heard part of it.
I got really confused after hearing, “Start quiet and end with a bang!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were working on the new song for our event, and this one started saying all these weird things.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what you guys were doing?
Mind if I listen to it? I might get a better idea of what you're talking about if I did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, go for it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, now I understand.
I guess it could have a better bang.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Kotaro gets it!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I think I do.
Akito, you probably shouldn't hold back so much here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why is this my fault all of a sudden?!
Ugh... Isn't there anyone else I can discuss this with?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
What's so bad about us?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, what she said!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Alright, you two. Quit teasing, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Finally, someone who'll understand...
Please, help...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I decided to eavesdrop a bit since it seemed like you two were talking about something interesting. But I think An's trying to say how...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that! Varying the tempo!
It should sound a lot quieter in the beginning and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We can increase the number of notes for the chorus. BOOM! Like a huge explosion of energy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why couldn't you say that before?! Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Still, you two seem to make tracks in a very interesting way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were just discussing how to make it better while listening to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito was having trouble understanding what I was trying to say.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly, you brushed off my comment like it was nothing but hung on Arata's every word.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, Akito, you big bully!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono's comment was completely different from what you two said!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you started messing with me partway through.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? No, I wasn't...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, Akito, you're pretty stubborn.
I think you should relax and have more fun with this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, back to our song!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Humhumhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Hm? You seem pretty happy considering how you were asked to do all these menial tasks, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, can you tell?
The new songs for our next event are ready!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And they're off the hook!
Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
They're really cool, and filled to the brim with everybody's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Ah, is that so?
Does “everybody” mean you all made them together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, not me. I still don't really know how to write my own tracks...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
I see.
But what kinds of songs are they?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll just have to come to our event to find out! They're guaranteed to knock your socks off!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
I don't mind going...
But if I do, I'll be holding you to your word and expecting an incredible event.

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Like the one Ken and his team put on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Well, I guess it wouldn't be fair to expect that much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we're still nowhere near our goal, and we have no idea if we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND with our next event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we're always prepared to, and we sing like we mean it. Our new songs are also a testament to that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My three teammates and I are serious about what we're doing. That goes for the other teams we'll be performing with too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you wanna see an event like the one you saw that night, then come see ours!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You won't be disappointed! I guarantee it!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
H-Hahahah...!
That's Ken's daughter for you!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: I have a good idea of what your songs are like now, without having to go to your event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, was that your goal?!
Were you egging me on to say what I just said?! You're awful!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Oh, relax.
When you're my age, you feel the need to test a youngster's mettle. I meant no harm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, anyway...
What's the verdict, my friend?

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Well...
I wouldn't mind seeing this event of yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
That's a promise! I'll be waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be looking forward to seeing something special, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, that means we'll need to practice even more! Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, sorry for making you wait like this. I know we agreed to practice today, but I've already finished washing the dishes, so once my dad gets back...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Hm?
That sounds like Ken's motorcycle...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
Perfect timing♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I are gonna go practice! Can you tell my dad that I've finished washing the dishes?

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, Kohane, we're gonna sing our hearts out again today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The new song the others wrote, and how they feel, of course...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They firmly revolve around surpassing RAD WEEKEND. They want to do that more than anything.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That means I can't drag my feet...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(For everyone's sake...
So that I can surpass RAD WEEKEND with them... I have to complete my song.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best during practice today, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Holiday
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry for making you guys stay after practice like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I didn't have any other plans today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what is it that you wanted to talk about? It didn't sound like it had to do with our event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I've been wanting to take a survey.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A survey?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's almost Christmas, so we've been thinking about putting out a seasonal menu like we usually do.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We're decided on chicken for the entree, but still haven't agreed on a dessert.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have two candidates that are both really good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, we want to decide by asking what our regulars think!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. If that's the case, I'd like to help, but...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I know that sweets aren't exactly your thing, so we won't force you to eat anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, that's what Akito's for!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You have the biggest sweet tooth out of all of us! Therefore, we definitely need to see what you think.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, give me one second while I go get the samples.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, our candidates are honey waffles and French toast!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The honey waffles have whipped cream sandwiched between them and a nice helping of ice cream covered in berry sauce on top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The French toast is a fairly standard affair. Crispy on the outside and gooey on the inside!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Those both sound really yummy...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's covered in berry sauce, you should be able to handle it, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to have some.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Speaking of which, have your families all started getting ready for Christmas?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not decorated yet, but we got our tree out already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, my mom's also started putting decorations up...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Isn't it still kinda early for that?
We usually wait until the last minute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! Us too.
This place sort of comes first, so we usually rush to get everything set up on Christmas Eve.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and does Santa Claus stop by you guys' places too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Every year.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My family's Santa usually asks these roundabout questions to see what I want for Christmas. I usually know what's going on, but I play along since it's so sweet of him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. So that's how your family goes about that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does that mean Santa is more direct at your house, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's usually the case.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! That means you get to ask for exactly what you want!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What about your family, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We sort of do that too because Ena won't shut up if we don't.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And? What about you guys...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, us?
Hmm... I don't think I've ever been asked what I want for Christmas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And yet...
I always seem to get what I want.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's incredible.
I suppose we shouldn't expect any less from Ke... I mean, Santa Claus.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right...?
How does he always know?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
Here are your honey waffles and French toast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...! These smell delicious!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Toya, neither have syrup on them, so you should also be able to try some.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm looking forward to trying them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's split them into quarters.
Starting with the French toast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Dad...
There's something I wanna ask you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Shoot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I always seem to get exactly what I want for Christmas, but I usually never say anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How does Santa Claus always know?
Does Mom help out with that?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You'll have to ask him yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm in high school now.
You don't have to hide it from me anymore.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. To us parents, you'll always be our little ones.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, you should have some dessert too... Before they eat it all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Grr. I'm gonna unravel the mystery of Santa Claus someday.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Good luck.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's get our Christmas party started!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, who still hasn't had stuff from our seasonal menu yet? I'll take your orders now!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Oh, I'll have the chicken!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Same here, An!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Can we get three honey waffles for our table, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Got it!
Two chickens and three honey waffles!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay, sugar connoisseurs, your honey waffles are ready! Can someone carry them over for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, we got more orders.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya, here's your matcha chiffon cake with no whipped cream! And EVER, here's your chicken!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Great, thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let me know if you guys want refills! Also, I'll be right there to round up any dishes that need bussing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, how do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You haven't had anything to eat since we started, right? Do you want some of my waffles?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean it?! Then, I think I'll have a small bite.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, your hands are all full. Here, open wide for the airplane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ahh... Mmm! Yum!
Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Things seem much calmer now, An. Go ahead and relax for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Lemme just get the dishes out of the way first!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back, everyone!
What were you guys all talking about just now? It sounded like fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An, welcome back!
We were just telling each other about our favorite foods.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, Mita was saying how he likes strawberries...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, they're best as is! I mean, I understand liking strawberry jam, but candy? Seriously, what's the deal with those?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh? I actually like both of those. Still, I'm not sure I like any particular foods to that degree.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Aside from chocolate parfaits, I do like rice omelets. Actually, I sort of see all foods with egg on top as those.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, how about yakisoba with a fried egg on top?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure even I could call that a rice omelet...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: If anything, it's a noodle omelet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, that's true!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, I'm kinda surprised.
I thought you'd have stronger preferences, Tono.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I get told that often.
Soma likes to make quips about that as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since we're on the subject, what are Soma's favorite foods?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hm? He likes omelets.
The sweet kind.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So you both like eggs.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Not quite. I like rice omelets, not eggs themselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't really understand your reasoning... But whatever floats your boat.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member A
rows.Line: Oh, you guys should ask what Tatsuya likes. You might not believe it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Then, mind if we ask?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Huh? It's not that surprising.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what do you like?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Squid sashimi.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line:
H-Haha...!
It never gets old! He's such an old man!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Hey, it just means I have a sophisticated palate.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The Christmas parties we throw always end up being fun...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it's really fun this year since we're all getting to know each other a lot better!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Through these sorts of conversations, we'll grow closer and closer.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And eventually become performers who can put on a legendary event, like Dad and his team...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, it's time to kick the party up a notch! So, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, now?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You guys all having fun?
I think it's about time we started singing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An, wait!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, we're at the mall.
Let's start doing some shopping!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're here to buy stuff for when we go to stay at your dad's friend's lodge in the mountains, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But is there that much we need...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Snacks, drinks, sweets and such!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, don't snacks and sweets fall under the same category?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No way!
We need snacks for the drive over and sweets for after we get there♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, it's really nice that the four of us all get to go since the camping trip we went on was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Definitely!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've been so busy with events and stuff lately, so it'll be nice to spread our wings and relax during New Year's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, we learned during our camping trip that doing stuff as a team matters a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! And performing at the lodge should be a good experience for all of us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that... Skiing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I went skiing when I was really little, but haven't since... I'm not sure how I'll do after so long...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Is that all?
You'll be fine! I'll help you brush up when we're there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You will? Wait, An, I thought you wanted to go snowboarding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I do, but Toya's also a beginner, so we should help each other out until we all get the hang of things!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean it? Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, let's start getting everything we need to make our skiing trip as fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That includes the snacks I just mentioned, but we're also gonna need some cold-weather gear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll be warm once we're on the slopes, but it's probably going to be cold otherwise.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, wanna get some hand warmers?
Let's see... Which shop sold daily necessities... Hm?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, check this out! It's an electric hand warmer!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a rabbit and a bear!
That's so cute! I didn't know they made these!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And this one looks like a macaron.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Do you think Akito would try to eat it if we hid it in our sweets pile?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I know he has a sweet tooth, but I'm sure he'll realize what it is after he sees it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah...
But it's hilariously cute, so let's get it anyways!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That just leaves... Oh, they have warm and fluffy socks! We should get some to make sure our toes stay warm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I almost forgot! Wanna get some games that we can play at the lodge after it gets dark? I have cards already, so how about a board game or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, that sounds like a lot to carry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry! We're gonna rent all our skiing equipment over there, so one or two board games won't hurt!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, what else is there...? Oh, this blanket's adorable! And big! We can probably use it together, Kohane, so I'll grab this too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you know what you're gonna buy, Kohane? Anything you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll get some of those socks you just got.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, these do look nice!
And they feel so soft!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They come in a few different designs. Which do you wanna get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... What if I got the one you chose but in a different color?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't mind, but I think some of these other really cute ones would suit you better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just thought that it might be fun to have matching pairs...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know this is different from when we do a show... Or do you think it'll be too embarrassing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I won't be embarrassed at all!
So, let's get matching pairs!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: While we're at it, wanna get matching scarves and beanies?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Hehe. Then, let's take a closer look at what they have to offer...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
I hope we can put together some really cute outfits.
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(He's definitely still got it...
However...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's go time...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa! That was close...!
Anyway... Woohoo! I won!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez... You wanted to win so badly that you almost couldn't stop.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I went up a gear because I had a feeling that I could! And I stopped in time, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, Shinonome, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey!
How's skiing going? Are you having fun?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we just managed to get down the top of the bunny slopes together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Did you guys use the chairlift?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we walked...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've both figured out how to actually ski, but I still don't feel great about going on the chairlift...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right.
But at least the skiing's fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all go down something together to finish? I wanna see how much you two have improved.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, snowboarding was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that, Kohane, Toya, you two have improved so much since you started practicing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because you guys were great teachers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I never imagined that I'd learn to ski this well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Anyway, what are we gonna do after this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, Dad's supposed to come pick us up, but he might not be here for a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we already returned all the stuff we rented, so wanna just keep hanging out?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang out...? What's there to do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose we could have a snowball fight since we normally don't get such an opportunity to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do that!
Wanna split into teams of two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay.
But who's gonna be with who?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Snowball fights aren't exactly your strong suit, right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I can dodge snowballs just fine, but throwing them is a separate issue...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You should be fine as long as you can dodge them. So, we can start with us teaming up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, I wanted her on my team.
But I guess that makes things more balanced.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Toya, let's do our best to completely cover Akito in snow!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why just me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... I promise to do my best, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, don't go easy on An.
She'll be in tears once we're done with her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! I-I'm not sure I want to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, how do we decide who wins? I don't really know the rules for this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, we have teams of two...
So, let's just make it something simple. How about if you get hit five times, you're out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds good!
Is that okay with you two?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Hehe. This is going to be so much fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's get started...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, let's practice first and give ourselves time to come up with a plan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I get strategizing. But practice...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Actually, we probably should if we want Toya to get the most out of this experience...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Let's take some time to practice. Also, to make snowballs!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright.
Then, let's start brainstorming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! We aren't going easy on you guys, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Neither are we!
Right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's start planning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
Crawl Green

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Now, I hope our negotiations today go well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! I'm gonna give you all the support I can, so let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? You sound rather energized, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I volunteered to do this, so I feel that I need to see to it properly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, if we do get to sing at Crawl Green, I promise to put on a performance that's going to floor everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be there with you! After all, we're teammates!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right. I'll be right next to you as well. We can rewrite history, together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's put on a show that totally erases what happened back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have a feeling that we're gonna get the green light today.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Same.
Especially since we have “that” ready this time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
After he sees that, I'm sure he'll...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Ah, sorry about the wait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi! Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting you to join him for this, An. However, don't think that I'm going easy on you just because we've known each other for a long time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know!
What's the point if we're not actually good enough, right?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yes, my point exactly.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: So, since you brought an additional negotiator this time, I have to believe that you have some new information for me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, we do. Remember how we discussed our second event last time? It was called “JET”.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
I've been hearing good things about that.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: In particular, my regulars have been raving about the new song An and her team performed at the start.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
My teammate, Toya, wrote it.
It was actually the first time we performed one of his songs.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: The first time...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! He'd written a few up until then, but he wasn't happy with any of them. As a result, we never got a chance to sing them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But he's a classically trained musician, so he has an amazing feel for music!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got goosebumps just after hearing the demo for that song!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It was so well made that we actually ended up shuffling around our set list to accommodate it.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Interesting... Then, I'd very much like to see what this second event of yours was like.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You brought a video of it today, no?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
You did hint at it quite a bit.
Anyway, you can pop it in over there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! We'll do that right now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've listened to it a bunch of times already, but Toya really did write an amazing song. The owner's also watching really intently...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think we should make a bigger point of the songs we chose or how everyone performed and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
No...
I think just letting him watch what happened will be quicker.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Okay.
Is that it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! Thanks for watching it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh no, he doesn't look all that impressed... So he wasn't totally moved by what he just saw?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hey, Arata, we might be in trouble!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Don't worry. There's no need to fret.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, what did you think...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: When...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Your event. When do you want to do it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: See? We're fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! We did it♪

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Now, we have a lot to discuss, so let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(We did it, you guys!
We get to perform at Crawl Green...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Just wait!
We'll be right there with the good news!)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: An, here's your crepe with bananas and chocolate!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! So much whipped cream! Your crepes always look amazing!

rows.Speaker: Crepe Shop Lady
rows.Line: And here's yours Kohane! Strawberries with whipped cream! Good luck with your event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much! We promise to do our best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's eat these over there, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmm!
Her crepes are so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they're filled to the brim with whipped cream, but these big strawberries also give it a lot of volume.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, Kohane, I don't think I've ever had that one before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like a bite?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Then, I'll take a nibble out of this part.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmm!
The whipped cream goes so well with these strawberries!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for that, Kohane!
In return, want some of my banana and chocolate crepe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Then, how about this part...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
You can have more than that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How about here?
It looks like a yummy clump of bananas and chocolate, so stick your spoon right in.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mmm...! Hehe. It's so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...?
Oh, is there something stuck to my face?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is there some cream on my cheek?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's not that.
I just like how much you're enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Want another bite?
How about this part? It's loaded with whipped cream!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But there won't be any left for you if I keep eating it.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whew! That was delicious!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're done already, An?
I'm still working on mine...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's okay. We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, Kohane...
You seem totally at home here now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. You know pretty much everybody at every shop around here now, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know about most of the shops, but there's still a couple that I haven't been to yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like the cafe that's right next to Weekend Garage...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It has this sort of mature feel to it and I'm sure it's also really nice inside, but I always end up going to Weekend Garage instead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there!
My dad said that it's been there since he was a kid.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's the place with the cream soda he liked.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?! It's that cafe? I really want to go now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's all go check it out together sometime!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, their coffee, tea and curry are also supposed to be really good! Not just the cream soda! Despite being a cafe, they give you really big portions...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, that's everything I had planned for our little date!
How was it? Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? Wait, this was a date?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I came up with a special plan that included you smiling and having some delicious food!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You do? Awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, all that's left is our meeting at Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, we don't have much time...!
Kohane, let's start heading over!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: That was delicious, An. See you!

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you! Take care!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay. I've flipped the closed sign, so now I need to tidy up and help get us ready to open the bar.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have plenty of time before practice with the team, but I'll be too busy to squeeze in solo practice before that...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I still need to practice more...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've gotta sing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's all I can do!)

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Dad! I need a favor!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, look! An's out here singing again!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: And just as well as ever! She's got far more soul than the usual lot around here.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Of course she does! Just look at that insane event her team pulled off at Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: You're right there! There's no one closer than An and her team to surpassing that legendary night!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's not enough! It needs more passion!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The kind of intense singing that drives people wild...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Nice work, An! You were really singing like you meant it just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you. But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do if you're satisfied with that? I need to keep pushing forward to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: That's the spirit! You and your team might actually pull it off!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, I need to go meet them for practice now.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Got it. Good luck!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We might actually pull it off, huh?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like something's changed in this town.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Not long ago, when we told people we were going to surpass that night...they did give us their support, but it never felt like they genuinely meant it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess everyone looks at us differently now that we're hosting our own events.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everyone's optimistic for us, but I'm not...making any progress...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I really do need to practice more.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I already asked Dad to shorten my hours at Weekend Garage. So, starting from tomorrow...)
An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, you're on the way to the park, right?
Wanna go together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe, it's a good thing I bumped into you. There's actually something I wanted to ask you about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ask me about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. The thing is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Hinomori is coming to Weekend Garage this Saturday to pick up the flyers for her solo show?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Sorry for using your place like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't even worry about it! My dad won't care either.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think Hinomori will have time to stop for a drink? I'd like to treat her to a tea or something as thanks for her help at the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That would be nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's strange...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Before, I was burning with that feeling that I had to keep singing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now, walking beside Kohane, I feel warm...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This is where I want to be.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to stay here. Now and forever.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's right. I'm Kohane's...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to do it...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (For now, all I can do is sing. Sing and sing as much as I can...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Just wait, Kohane...)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Agreed! Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, good work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you plan to do after this? I'll be going to MEIKO's cafe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll join you then. We've been practicing so much that I haven't dropped by in a while.
