rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I'll come as well! What about you, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, there's something I have to do after this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you helping your dad out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, something like that! We're super busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't overdo it. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now then...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This spot looks okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm still warmed up and I haven't lost my voice.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which means I can go harder...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Nice. Now to keep this up and...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm projecting even more than before. I guess practice is paying off.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (One more time, while I'm still in the zone...)
<An.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? That voice...
Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup, that's right.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it is you! Why did you pop up all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone except you came to visit us, so I was wondering what was up...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just like I figured, you're practicing alone, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I am.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey, is it okay if I listen to you for a while?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! While you're at it, feel free to give me any pointers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, got it. I'll be listening in then.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, and thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
How was I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I could really feel the power behind your singing. And you sang with a lot of emotion.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It feels like your singing has changed from when I heard you recently.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, recently? When?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Uh... About a week ago, maybe?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ah, it's pitch black... Well, of course it is. She must be practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope I get the chance to hear everyone sing... It's been so long.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (We haven't gotten a chance to meet up in SEKAI lately since they've been practicing with other teams so much.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It sounds like their last event was incredible, and I'm sure they're putting that same energy into their practice.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, there it is.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Huh...? I can only hear An's voice. Maybe she's practicing solo again?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's singing with even more force than usual. But, it's not just that...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's this desperation in her voice that's almost painful, like she's thrashing around trying to grab hold of something.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... So you were there when I was practicing alone that time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I didn't mean to eavesdrop... It's just that I didn't want to disturb you, and I thought there might be other people around.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no need to worry about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More importantly, did you say my singing changed? What did you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The desperation was still there, but I didn't get a sense of pain like I did last time.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <How should I put it... It's like, before, you were thrashing under the water and about to drown, but now you're splashing around on the surface... I guess?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry, that one got away from me.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's okay. I think I got what you meant.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And the reason my singing changed has to be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I never intended to put any painful emotions into my singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, that can't be helped. When we sing, we throw out one big lump of our emotions.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For better or worse, it's pure truth. Of that, I'm sure.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. I'm still in the mood to sing. Can you listen to me practice for a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll listen for as long as you want. I want to hear more of this new An.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's meet up with Arata and the others, and go find Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
He's really heading back to the US. It feels too soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I first heard that he'd be heading back to the US to go on tour, I didn't realize just how famous an artist he really is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, as famous as he is, I'm having a hard time telling what he's like as a “professional”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, isn't Nagi also in the United States right now? Is she going to tour with him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dunno. It didn't sound like they were doing anything together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know! I can ask Uncle Taiga to ask her to come back to Japan if she ever gets some free time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I tell her that I'm in a team now, she'll definitely want to come see us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I hope I get to meet her too.
I really want to ask her about what you were like when you were little, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! No! Nuh-uh! She's totally gonna say the most embarrassing things about me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh? In other words, there's a lot of stuff that you don't want us knowing about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, no! What are you talking about?! Anyway, let's get going!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, so... See that little shop over there? I just remembered how Aunt Nagi and I used to go there a lot together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That could be because we were just talking about her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just so you know, we don't have time to take any detours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I still go there occasionally, but I always find myself reminiscing whenever I do...)

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line:
Well, if it isn't Nagi and An.
Come on in!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, is it true that your husband got hurt? Is he okay?

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Him? Are you talking about how he got scratched by a cat?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? A cat?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I heard that his hand was wrapped in bandages. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Oh, that. He wouldn't stop whining, so I decided to wrap up his hand like a mummy.

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: I mean, he's a grown man for crying out loud. But he wouldn't stop complaining about this tiny cut on the back of his hand.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha! I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
He always likes to listen to me sing, so I was really worried when I didn't see him yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Thank you both for being so kind, Nagi, An.

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Still, you two are so close. I see you all the time together. You're almost like sisters.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sisters...? That seems like a stretch considering how much older I am than her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And you treat me like your own daughter because you've known me since I was little... But remember, I'm all grown up now.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: What? If you're such a grown-up, Aunt Nagi, why'd you take my snacks away from me?

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Oh? Have you been a naughty girl, Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: No, you're getting the wrong idea! I won them from her fair and square!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Also, An, you agreed to our little bet knowing what could happen. No takesies-backsies!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Grr... But you said you'd double what I had if I won...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: It's your own fault for getting greedy.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Also, I only took half and gave you the rest, didn't I? See, I did the grown-up thing!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: How does that count as being a grown-up?!

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Haha! You two really are inseparable.

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Why don't you two stay for some snacks? It'll be my way of thanking you both for showing so much concern for my husband.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Just mention snacks and it's hook, line and sinker...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hmph. You're not getting any, Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, don't say that.
Same offer. I'll double what you get if you beat me at rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm not falling for that again.

rows.Speaker: Little An & Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Little An & Nagi
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna leave you behind if you keep spacing out like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, sorry.
I was just reminiscing a bit!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About Nagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, you gotta hear about the time she...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get home safe, guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you tomorrow... No, wait. We're not having practice tomorrow, are we?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You all fought pretty hard against Taiga, right? You need to give your throats a chance to recover.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See you later, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! See you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We need to get back on our feet!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want tea instead?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I feel like coffee today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is nice.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, there she is.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry for calling you so suddenly. I know you're busy.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: It's okay. This is important.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mom...?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Your eyes are bloodshot...
And, did you lose your voice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...
Haha. Yeah, kinda...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what's up? You hardly ever come here.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: You heard about Nagi, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means... Mom, you also knew?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sorry about keeping quiet this whole time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's okay...
Dad explained why no one told me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And what Aunt Nagi was thinking.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Because I believe in what I said.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: If anyone's going to succeed us, I'm absolutely positive that An will be one of those people.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, it's okay...!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Then, did you hear about this...?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Nagi always said she wanted to be the cool big sister you could always count on and look up to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Taiga kept laughing at her that you were more like her daughter because she was so much older than you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But being my daughter would mean I'd have to actually be responsible for her, wouldn't it? I don't think that kind of relationship suits us.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm going to be more like her friend or buddy...
Ooh, or we can be a pair of sworn sisters who like to stir things up!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We both love this city and want to do everything together. We want to see what this world has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And I think that An and I will, together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Still, you two are so close. I see you all the time together. You're almost like sisters.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sisters...? That seems like a stretch considering how much older I am than her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, don't say that.
Same offer. I'll double what you get if you beat me at rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm not falling for that again.

rows.Speaker: Little An & Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Little An & Nagi
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
...
An, it's okay. Just let it all out...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I... I'm not stopping...!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: You've become so strong...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Have you ever heard the saying about how the tears of mourners help flowers grow in heaven?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: For every mourner, a flower blooms up above for their loved one. In other words, the more mourners, the more flowers.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Nagi was supposed to rest on a great bed of flowers...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
But we chose to respect her wishes.
We chose to deprive her of that...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
So, An...
It's okay for you to cry now.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Don't feel bad about crying. You have every right to, considering just how much you loved her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Little An & Nagi
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Cry*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I...! I wish we could've talked more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And stood on stage together...!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
I know, dear...
I would've loved to see that as well...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(Let it all out...
For me. For all of us...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Cry*
An's birthday
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin, Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're ready too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then. I'll light the candles.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Blow them all out, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! You got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone!
*Blow*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, An♪
Okay, cake time! C'mon, let's cut it up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Someone's a little too eager for a slice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the one who's already got a fork in his hand.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oops. You got me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm just as excited as you are. This rum raisin pound cake looks so yummy, I can barely sit still!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, An. Truthfully, I think a more typical birthday cake would've been better though...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The candles don't really match, do they?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's nothing! I couldn't be happier. This thing's stuffed with rum-soaked raisins!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. Makes me feel better knowing that the birthday girl approves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, I used the leftover ingredients to make rum raisin ice cream, so feel free to have some for dessert.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on, doesn't the pound cake also count as a dessert?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then, I'll cut the cake. There's plenty of food and snacks to go around, so don't hold back, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okey dokey! Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO! Please make sure to cut all the slices the same size except for An's piece!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah! An's the birthday girl, so she can get the biggest piece♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure? Then a big slice for me please, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But... Are you gonna be okay eating that much?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't you say you were going to have another celebration with your other friends?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I did, but there's still loads of time until then, so it's all good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well yes, but perhaps don't overdo it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If she stuffs herself until she can't move, we can just leave her behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! You'd seriously just up and leave without the birthday girl?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't worry, An. I'd never leave you behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
K-Koohaanee...!
You seriously are the best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, An.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... So we're supposed to meet up around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, there they are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey Mizuki! Hello Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nice to see you all again. Thank you for going out of your way to invite me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not a problem at all! Thank you for coming, even though you're so busy with art studies!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know about “busy”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah...good ol' sibling affection.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So true!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, you were the one who organized everything, right, Mizuki? Thank you for booking the cafe and planning all of this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, yeah... Let's talk about that more later♪ We gotta start heading over to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right. We've got people waiting for us over there, don't we!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wouldn't want to make them wait, so let's—
Halt! You there...it is your birthday today, is it not?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! Look who it is!

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Green
rows.Line: “P-Providing negative air ionization and comforting songs! Happy B'Day Green!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Purple
rows.Line: “Bringing you an explosive celebration and performance! Happy B'Day Purple!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Orange
rows.Line: “Blazing with celebrative energy that can rival the sun! Happy B'Day Orange!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Orange
rows.Line: “And together we're...”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Rangers
rows.Line: “The celebration squad, Happy B'Day Rangers!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! You three are the best♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Umm... What are you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't it obvious? We are here to give you a surprise show! You were on the way to meet us at the cafe, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that was all part of the surprise! How was it? I'm sure you found yourself astounded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well it sure was different to what I was told... I was really surprised to see you all suddenly start dancing at a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Surprised? Are you sure you don't mean put off?
See? This is why I was against it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Emu had so kindly come up with this idea for us. I didn't want her efforts to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I heard that you were all coming, but I didn't know that you'd be putting on a surprise show for us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
I was so surprised that I couldn't react properly!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Liar. You cringed like any regular person would.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No I didn't!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we should be getting a move on. We're also attracting a lot of attention right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good idea! Alright then, to the cafe we go♪
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-da! This cafe was picked out by Ena and yours truly♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is the place that has those cupcakes with the really cute decorations, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! Also, there's a small flower garden at the back of the cafe too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's really pretty, so shall we take a group photo there later?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, I'd love that!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Booking for Mizuki, your table is ready. Please come this way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, our table's over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright everybody, go all the way in. Oh, you take the front, An♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on... Aren't there a little too many seats?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's okay, An. That's because—
Those seats are for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka! And you guys too?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! Hinomori, you're here too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Kohane, Minori and Kiritani invited me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you for coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh my gosh, I didn't expect the members of MORE MORE JUMP to be here too! Especially since you're all so busy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, our birthday celebration organizer asked us to save the date for this afternoon in advance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, organizer?
Mizuki, I thought you were the one who organized all of this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, I was just a mere helper. The true person behind all of this is Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't know about that since all I did was contact you, Mizuki. Without you and the others, I wouldn't have been able to put this together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Especially since I didn't know who An was close with from Kamiyama High.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why we asked for Mizuki's help to invite everyone from Kamiyama High.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't realize!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did all of this for me even though you're all so busy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well it is for my best friend's birthday after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-W-Wait, hold on! D'aw... Why're you doing this to me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is us we're talking about. You didn't have to do this much for me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may think that, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless of whether we haven't spoken in a while or we suddenly decide to meet up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No matter what happens, you always come meet me with a smile on your face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Well, yeah. I mean you're my best friend. Of course I'd do that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...in hindsight of what happened recently, I felt like it wasn't fair for you to always spoil me with your kindness.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Spoil you...? I never saw it like that though...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. But I also knew you were going to say that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I want to tell you this properly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An... Thank you so much for always being a great friend and being there for me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's continue to be best friends forever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you talking about? Of course! You're both my best friend and rival, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An... Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: T-That is so sweet!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It is! What a wonderful friendship!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's so nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm happy for you, An.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone! This celebration is far from over♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You said it! I'm starving and ready for some post-work eats.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have also just finished practice, so we too, are famished.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! Then we better get ordering!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi! I'm glad that the surprise successfully put a smile on your face! There is nothing else that could satisfy me more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not sure if we can call the surprise a success...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Shiraishi, I guess we may have “surprised” you but please know that our birthday wishes came from the heart.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Please do come and watch one of our shows sometime. I hope you have a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi. Thanks for letting me be there to celebrate with you. It was so lively and I had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See, I told you it'd be fun! Me, Rui and the others worked hard putting on that surprise, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, happy birthday! You've always helped me out in class, so I wanted to express my gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, how was it? Did you have fun? See you around at school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, An♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's amazing to see so many people come and celebrate with you, An. I guess you're just that loveable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She really is. We all had so much fun at the party. It has become a wonderful memory for me too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We only just got to know each other but I'm glad I was there. We also got to talk about music and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Birthday parties are super fun and lively with so many people♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad that everyone there was able to have a great time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An, happy birthday. As your best friend, I'm always here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday. Also, how many more times have we gotta say this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As many times as we wish. It is her birthday, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An! I know lots of your close friends were there at the celebrations, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm going to keep working hard to be the best partner you could ever have, okay? Look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: From my teammates to friends and even my seniors at school... Having so many people to celebrate my birthday with just makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I better treasure today's memories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you so much for all of the birthday wishes! I'll be counting on your support!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That hall monitor meeting really dragged on.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Lunch service at the cafe's probably gonna be over by the time I get there.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ramen Shop Owner
rows.Line: Hey, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey! Long time no see!
Sorry it's been so long since I last came by the shop.

rows.Speaker: Ramen Shop Owner
rows.Line: No, that's all good...

rows.Speaker: Ramen Shop Owner
rows.Line: An, I'm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, gotta go! I promised to help out at the cafe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I couldn't look him in the eye...
Not only that, he seemed a little hesitant about talking to me too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everyone around here is probably aware that I know the truth about Aunt Nagi now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I made the decision to keep moving forward, and I told Dad everything that he needed to hear.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to talk with all the locals the same way I always have...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I guess I haven't sorted out my feelings as well as I think I have.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's been awkward serving them at the cafe too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, stop...!
Things feel awkward because you make them awkward!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You just have to treat everyone the way you always have. I know you can do that much.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, welcome back.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
No customers at the moment.
I closed a little early since we sold out during lunch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Oh, right. The sign out front said, “Closed”.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, are you having trouble talking to everyone around town...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I sorta am...
I keep clamming up for some reason. It's like I don't know how to face them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But don't worry!
I just need a little time to figure things out! I'll have things back to normal in no time!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You shouldn't have to say any of this.
I mean, it's our fault for putting you in this situation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Okay, why don't we do this?
You don't have to help out here for a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! But you'd have to do so much more work!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't mind me. You reap what you sow, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And you and your team spoke about trying to find more time to practice, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we did...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes. You should focus on what you want to do right now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You can think about all this other stuff when you feel the time is right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, I'll do that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Dad.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you practicing here again today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, since my dad isn't supposed to start joining us for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is he still cleaning and packing everything up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's that, but also something else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He needs time to come up with what we should do when we practice and all that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. He even said that...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm going to take this opportunity to teach you all everything I can.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: In other words, I'm betting on you using all that I have at my disposal.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, you're going to have to fully commit yourselves to singing and staying in shape. I'll be running you all ragged until you can't stand any longer, every single day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You're not gonna be able to stand?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
He didn't mean that literally.
He was just making a point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
U-Uh, right!
Still, what's he gonna have you guys do...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He mentioned physical fitness, so I'm guessing he's gonna have us run and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Run...?
That's a little worrying for me since I don't have as much stamina as the rest of you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm worried as well... It may be good for us to do some conditioning before we start practicing with Ken.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, we can have another footrace!
I promise to give it everything I have again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everything you have...? Didn't you only cheer last time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cheering's important, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you and Len both did a ton of cheering for us that time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd really like to have that again since I'm not sure if I'd be able to finish the course all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Strength training may also be included in what he said.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yikes... Strength training...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Is that not really your thing, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I don't hate it or anything...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's so boring to do the same thing over and over again, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's your reasoning...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Whimper*
I feel even less sure about strength training than I do about running...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, let's try to do our best together if your dad makes us do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't feel great about it, but if it means us becoming better singers... Let's do our best together, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, what about singing practice?
Did An's dad say anything about that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, he hasn't given us any details regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your dad's watched you sing a number of times before, right, An? Can you make any guesses based on that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... He taught me how to sing when I was really little, so... I remember him talking about maintaining a good posture and how to project my voice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, so the basics.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Practicing the basics is incredibly important. A good foundation can greatly affect how you adapt to specific situations.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, we've all made the commitment to deal with whatever he throws at us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's gonna be some growing pains, but we just gotta do our best and keep each other's spirits up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then... What if he asks us to do three sets of a hundred squats?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just squatting down and standing back up for who knows how long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oof... I don't know how long I'll be able to handle the silence...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... Can we chat or listen to music while we do it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're more concerned about that?
I thought you'd be worrying more about completing such a grueling workout.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha.
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm... Gnh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gnnargh!!! I'm too tired!!! I can't study anymore!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wah! Tsukasa exploded again!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My, is it that time already? Tsukasa is such a reliable timekeeper.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, I suppose it's time for a break.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I think it is...
Akito and Shiraishi seem tired too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A...break...? Yay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm...at my limit...
I'm going for some fresh air on the rooftop...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I might join you... My brain's barely functioning...

rows.Speaker: Rui & Mizuki
rows.Line: See you soon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro? Aren't you gonna join them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll pass. I don't want to move right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You're looking a little flushed. Why don't I open the window for a while to help you cool off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd like that... Thank you...
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's so cool! I feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can see clubs practicing from here. Look! The soccer club's having a practice match.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever felt this much envy for a sports club. This makes me want to move around...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right...?
If only we were having supplementary P.E. classes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I guess just going outside like this is a good enough change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I suppose. But...
The thing is...in weather as lovely as this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...?
Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I want to do my vocal exercises, NOOOOOOW!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Argh!!! What's got into you all of a sudden?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Apologies.
I couldn't help myself... Being in such a wide open space got the better of me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I've been restricting myself from a number of things. Vocal exercises, watching movies, going to musicals...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, what I need now is restraint! Rui is going out of his way to help me, and I need to pull my weight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If I let myself watch even one show, I don't think I'll have the willpower to not put one on myself...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like, all it takes is letting your guard down once to doom yourself and lose all motivation to study.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? You too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. I've been avoiding listening to music for that reason.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... They play music at lunchtime, right? That's the scariest part of my day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I start itching to sing along. So yes, I really understand how you feel...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... It seems we think the same way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That reminds me of something I've been thinking while sharing a classroom with you. You're surprisingly hardworking, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Surprisingly?
What do you mean, surprisingly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean surprisingly.
After all, aren't you always breaking the rules?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you realize how many times you and Kamishiro's names have come up in hall monitor meetings in just one year?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
I can't argue with that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That said, none of the hall monitors think that you're bad people.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Including me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shiraishi...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That doesn't change the fact that you should follow school rules!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, understood! I'll behave myself next year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you. I hope you will.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, shall we return to the classroom? But first, why don't you do it too, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I shouted out just now, I felt like I was able to release some pent-up emotions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It isn't healthy to constantly deny yourself the things you enjoy. Why don't you shout like I did?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
You might be right about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm sick of this!
I wanna siiiiiing!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That felt so good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. There was real moxie in that shout! I'd expect no less from you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Your singing! My shows!
Today takes us one step closer to passionately doing the things we love.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're right!
How about we head back now?
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huff... Huh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, can we go again from the top? I want to make up for lost time as quickly as I can...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay, got it. Here we—

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Dinner's ready, you two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh... Whoa!
Is it that time already?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But also, did you make dinner this time, Mom? That's unusual.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: I did. I got home early, so I figured I'd cook for once.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: To be fair, your father did most of the prep work. I just did the frying.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Speaking of which, tonight we're having tonkatsu! They turned out extra crispy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Tonkatsu?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Extra crispy, you say?
I'm looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, they should be nice. By the way, An, well done on getting through your supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Thanks!
Sorry for making you both worry.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe, we were never worried for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We didn't tell you, but... Your homeroom teacher told us, “If she puts in the effort, I will make sure she doesn't get held back.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously?! You could've told me...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: No way. It was a good opportunity for you to put some effort into studying.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I mean, we all have our strengths and weaknesses, and that can't be helped... But you've had a chance to reflect now, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only I was a good student like you two were...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Like we were?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Like, you're a teacher, Mom. And Dad, you always had good grades, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Come to think of it, I've never told you, have I?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: The truth is, I was once a bad student.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? You were?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: That's right. Back in junior high, I didn't see the point of school, and I never put in any effort.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Then, when I reached high school, I was in the same boat as you, An. My teacher came to me and said, “There's no way you're getting into second year like this!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why did you want to become a teacher?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: I'll tell you why. I had a very talented teacher.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: That teacher didn't just bring my grades up, but actually taught me to enjoy studying.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: And so I thought, “I want to be a teacher like that one day.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I totally thought you had always had good grades. Unlike me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, enjoying studying...
I think going through all this has taught me that...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I had these study sessions with my friends to get us through the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At first, I didn't understand Classical Japanese at all. It was like an alien language to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But once I started understanding it, I could start finding similarities in how me and those ancient people thought.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that felt...kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: In that case, An, you've gained something far more important than good grades.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure your teacher would be beaming with pride to know their student feels that way.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure it's been tough, but you've worked so hard!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mom!
I promise my grades will—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh... I guess school will get harder next year, so maybe I can't make any promises about that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I will keep studying hard!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on, while we're here talking, our dinner's getting cold! We can't let that extra crispy tonkatsu go soggy!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're right. Let's go home.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Your class was also given a pop quiz.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, who gives a pop quiz right at the start of a new school year?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Akito, Toya...
Sorry, but can I ask you guys something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what's up...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kinda need you guys' help...
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You wish to have lunch with Kusanagi, but things haven't been going as planned?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really want to talk to her about singing since we both love it. I've been doing my best to invite her, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kusanagi!
Wanna have lunch in the courtyard with us today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? “Us”?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I went around and managed to wrangle up a group of about ten. We can all introduce ourselves and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: T-Ten...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uhh...
Sorry, maybe next time. There's this video I've been meaning to watch.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may've been asking too much of her. I remember Tsukasa mentioning how she's very shy around people she doesn't know very well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, really...?!
I couldn't tell based on the last conversation we had since we talked so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, she even said no when it was just two or three of us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, she did have some stuff to do for the library committee that time, so the size of our group was probably not the issue....

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tried inviting her again after that, but Kamishiro and Tenma flew into our classroom and took her away before I could get a word out...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like my timing's been really bad, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, I suppose life happens.
At the same time, you're in the same class this year, so I'm sure you'll get more opportunities to invite her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Assuming your aggressiveness hasn't scared her off already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? I haven't scared...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No! Nuh uh! I definitely haven't...!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line: (She hesitated...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna get her to have lunch with me no matter what it takes...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya! Is Kusanagi scheduled to do stuff for the library committee tomorrow...?

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

Crase Cafe

rows.Line:
*Sigh*

rows.Line:

An?!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I'll have some milk tea and the fruit waffle sandwich!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: MEIKO, I need Luka's usual blend, a milk tea, a tuna sandwich, a grilled cheese and a fruit waffle sandwich!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Got it. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You seem right at home, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been doing this forever now. Plus, I always get to see how you and MEIKO run things around here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I want you to take it easy today♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I think I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Come on in, Toya!
I'll show you to your seat! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Are you helping out here today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Remember how my dad said we're not allowed to sing today? I was bored out of my mind, so I decided to give back a little by helping out here today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you want your usual blend?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and some cookies.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
The cookies are almost ready, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just give us a minute, Toya, and you'll get to have some fresh-baked ones. Want me to bring out your coffee when they're ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, I'll take the cookies out of the oven! MEIKO, can you take care of the coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for being so quick on your feet, An. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still... Shiraishi, it feels like it's been so long since you last waited on me like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It does feel like it's been forever! After all, we've been spending all our time practicing, and Dad closed our place down!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An! Can I order some more stuff?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, coming!
Enjoy your visit, Toya!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, it's getting pretty late.
Why don't you stop here for the day, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right!
I didn't realize what time it was!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was having so much fun helping you, MEIKO, that I completely lost track...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for helping me today, An.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, as a small token of my appreciation, I'd like you to have some pancakes on me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As a special treat, I'll throw lots of fruits on top, as well as a mix of whipped and custard cream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were a huge help today, so I'd like to reward you properly with a nice helping of food. So, Miku, let's also take our break now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Time to dig in♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still... Waiting tables really is nice!

rows.Speaker: An

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That should also be true of the events you perform in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh... You're right!
If the crowd reacts well, that can be a huge boost of energy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And seeing them bounce off the walls is seriously the best feeling in the world...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, you'll need to make that happen during your next event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I hope you, the others and the audience all get to have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We will! These pancakes are gonna be the fuel I need to keep doing my best!

Alleyway

rows.Line: No way...

rows.Line: She's like Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Line: (She really is the best...)

rows.Line: She still hasn't reached her ceiling...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't want to put Kohane on a pedestal like I did that time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't wanna sit by while she flies higher and higher... I don't wanna feel that pain anymore...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So, I have to face up to this.)

rows.Line: (I have to take a hard look at myself, face my problems, and Kohane...)

rows.Line: An? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, sorry! Nothing's wrong!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming along, Kohane!
I got the push I needed because you did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?

rows.Speaker: An

Now, let's head back.
You were gonna practice on your own after this, right?

Are you sure?

Woohoo! Wait, it's already this late...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
I know, right...?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Those were such good times.

Rawr...?

rows.Line: I see.

rows.Line: Hehe. It's so like you to feel that way, An.

rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Line: Actually, you've been like this for as long as I can remember.

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line: (But... I never imagined her losing.)

rows.Line: (But the team that beat Shiraishi last time was something else. I've gotta think they're gonna win again... Hm?)

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if I don't buck up, I won't actually be able to face Kohane tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (At times like these...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I should listen to some music.
A song that'll pump me up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know...!

rows.Line:
Okay.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (All the hard work we've been putting in.)

rows.Line: No, I didn't think that for a second...!

rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, my dad's calling!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what's up?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <Sorry for calling you so suddenly. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we're just checking out the area around the music school we stayed at last night.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
<Taiga's manager told me what happened...
Rough start to your trip, huh.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, you became worried and decided to call?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'd heard you found a safe place to stay, but I still wanted to check in.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for thinking about us.
We're doing just fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we got to spend a night at THE New York Academy of Music, so... Let's just call it a happy accident.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <If you say so...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Your dad seems like such a nice person.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Hey, can you guys hear me?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is Uncle Taiga with you?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <Yes, the idiot who can't book the right dates for a hotel is sitting next to me.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Hey, don't call me that. I got a reservation. It just happened to be one month from now! Hahaha!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
<Oh, don't worry...
He's going to get an earful from me later.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
<Hey, I was kidding.
It's an American-style joke. Get it?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We just got here, so I doubt any of us are going to understand.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Haha! Where did you learn to talk back?>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Anyway, I am sorry about all the trouble I caused you guys.>

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
<Don't worry, everyone...
Taiga's no longer allowed to handle anything like this.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Hey, you don't need to pile on like that...>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <I mean, I was just trying to be a generous host, since I was the one who invited them and all.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. It was actually kind of nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because you've had a habit of doing stuff like this for as long as I can remember!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
<The others don't need to know that.
I'm feeling lamer by the second.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <But that'll change soon.>

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: <Because you're going to forget about everything that happened after seeing my event.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <An, is Toya with you?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm here.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <I'm deeply sorry for what happened this time around. I'll be sure to properly thank your brother later for what he did.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
He told me to let him know if we needed help.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: <Sorry, Ken, but we have to go...>

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <Ah, of course.>

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
<Look after the others, An.
And let me know if anything else happens.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I will!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: <And keep an eye on An for me, you guys.>

rows.Speaker: Toya, Kohane & Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
Yes!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Things sounded really busy on their end.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They are in the middle of getting ready for their event, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Taiga and Ken both sounded very excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm honestly pretty stoked about getting to hear those two sing again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! The only other time I got to hear them sing together was that video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I haven't seen them perform together since that day either, I think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for their event!
New York Academy of Music - Cafeteria

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That supermarket was enormous!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The ceiling was really high, the shelves seemed to go on forever, and there were like twice as many aisles as in Japanese supermarkets!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I was really surprised when that student told us how the ones outside the city are even bigger.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty sure we all thought it was more than big enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The shops on the backstreet we visited yesterday were all fairly small. It may've felt bigger as a result.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When we entered, I was like, “Whoa, this place is huge!” And our jaws hit the floor when we saw how big the carts were!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You and An could've probably ridden them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I was honestly wondering why they were so big...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it all became clear when we saw how big the stuff on the shelves was. Everything was gigantic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The bags for the snacks were all like twice the size of what you see in Japan, remember?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You could even get eggs in whole flats instead of just cartons of ten.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we just happened to watch a family put two flats into their cart.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Other than running a business, why would anyone need that many eggs?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe they're going to boil them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Scrambled eggs and omelets seem like they'd take a lot of eggs, but even so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only did everything come in giant sizes, the variety was crazy too. Did you see how many different types of cereal they had?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. One of the staff told you something by the cereal, Toya. What did they say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They said, “The blue box there is our top-selling cereal brand. If you can't decide, I'd pick that.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They were talking really fast. You really understood what they were saying?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'd be lying if I said I got everything perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I managed to catch individual words, but I had to make an educated guess from there given the grammar and sentence structure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, all you sometimes need are a few words and phrases to paint most of the picture.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: With “top-selling” being the magic word in this case.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Top... Oh, right!
That means it's been selling the most!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Most of the actual words the employee used were on the simpler side.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As long as you calmly listen to what someone has to say, you should be able to get a rough understanding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought I'd gotten a lot better at speaking and listening, but I definitely still have a lot of room left for improvement...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too. My brain still freezes up a little whenever someone comes up to us and starts talking to us in English.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Mr. Lloyd, are you and Toya's dad...?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, what was that word?! It's on the tip of my tongue!

rows.Speaker: Student Ａ
rows.Line: “The way you improvised towards the end there was great!”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “Wanna play again, you guys? We can try a different song this time!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They all talk really fast, but I've understood what they've been saying...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna work on my listening skills, and get to where I can actually speak English with people!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Connecting with folks through music like we did at the session yesterday was fun too, and all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I want to actually talk to people about music. Like Mr. Lloyd and Toya's dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna ask them about the music they like, how they got into music and so much more!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've been getting the basic gist of what everyone's been saying, but I'm still having trouble responding. That's been a little frustrating.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! We came all this way to the United States, so I wanna really understand what everyone's saying!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever been more motivated to learn English!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, why don't we use this time to study?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not like we have anything else to do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let me help you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!
Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What you did just now was so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, that was staggering.
Where did you learn that technique?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... It just came to me, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember how we got to stay in the academy's dorms and sing with the students there?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After hearing the way they improvise and rearrange songs, I've been trying out a bunch of new things!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That would explain why you've been trying your hand at all those difficult singing techniques.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Every time you try, you either hit it out of the park or whiff like no other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not expecting all of my experiments to succeed!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually really enjoy seeing you trying out all those different techniques, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Kohane! That's what I wanted to hear!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, since that last part ended up going so well, wanna sing it again?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Then, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that went even better!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, I think I'll give this other technique I've been meaning to try out a whirl!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you're gonna try something else?! I wanna hear what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That one also sounded pretty good.
I just came up with something, so mind if I try it out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Go for it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
A new idea to complement Shiraishi's techniques.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd like to make a suggestion... It should help give our singing a little more depth.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to make a suggestion as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No problem! Let's keep trying everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How did that sound?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not bad, but I feel like it's missing something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I definitely hesitated a little during that transition. I'll do a better job of getting in sync with you next time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, I can try counting you in. That should make it easier for you to sing in unison.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! That was our best attempt yet!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we did what we set out to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, while that's still fresh in our minds, we should—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Stop right there!
Could you all wait a second?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sorry for throwing you off your groove, but you should take a break. You've already been at it for four hours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? We've been at it that long...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We had no idea either!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were all totally focused on perfecting this song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was fun to watch MEIKO's brow get increasingly furrowed with each passing hour.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you were aware, then you should've spoken up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
In any case, it's break time!
I'll need some of you to help me bring the drinks I made over from the cafe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I brought over those bottles like you asked, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. Could you put them over there for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, those four hours just flew by as you practiced, didn't they?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, they did. I think that was because we spent time trying out all those different ideas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Things really snowballed as soon as we started testing things out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because that first idea made us think of even more ideas that we thought would really work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! And we couldn't stop coming up with ideas after things got going!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why singing with you guys is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There really is nothing better than having teammates who all are serious about reaching the top!)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
An, Rin, welcome.
All done practicing for the day?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, for now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
For now?
Does this mean you're just taking a break? Are you going to keep practicing afterwards?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I'm going to work on my English!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd rather head over to the plaza where Kohane and Miku are practicing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she said she still has some studying left to do, so she's gonna work on that instead.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. You're really doing your best, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I am! I want to both get a better understanding of the language and spend more time speaking it!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful!
By the way, what about your studies besides English...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha...
Y-Yeah, I'll need to do something about that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be fair, you've already taken a massive step by overcoming your phobia of English.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, since you're studying so hard, I think you deserve a bit of dessert as a reward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm doing my best to cheer her on, MEIKO! And I promise to keep rooting for her lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, I'll get some for you too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...!
Kohane told me something interesting when I stopped by the plaza earlier.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After we touched those black fragments, she said you guys kept calling out our names while we were trapped in that dream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, we were hoping that we'd be able to wake you all up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were absolutely certain that you'd come back to us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you both, MEIKO, Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank us.
After all, it's our duty to watch over all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? I wouldn't mind being thanked more.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I've gone back to check up on that tree a few times since then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Any changes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No. After it went through that growth spurt, nothing has really changed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: MEIKO, didn't you say how that tree and our feelings are linked somehow?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I suspect that's the case.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... In other words, if we grow as a team or if our feelings change, then something should happen, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, probably!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, not only was that plaza created, but now we can go down those new alleyways since that big wall's gone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what do you think is gonna happen next?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anything is fine as long as it doesn't cause us any trouble!
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, you two.
Here are your usual drinks.

rows.Speaker: An & Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, An, how's your studying coming along?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh no, I forgot!
That's why I'm here in the first place!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Do your best.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you need my support, An, let me know! I'm always ready to cheer for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's so nice knowing that someone is right there to support you.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because it means I'm not alone.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, An, welcome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, where are the others today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They were here a second ago. They just went out somewhere to sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you by yourself today, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. I've been feeling kinda anxious, so I decided to come here to unwind a little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see. Then, I'll get you some hot milk.
I'll even add plenty of honey to make it extra sweet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Still, why am I feeling so anxious?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's natural for you to feel that way. After all, the big event is tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's gonna be the single biggest event I've ever been to, by any scale.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Tens of thousands are going to be there to watch it, and the artists performing are always at the top of the charts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You don't get many chances in life to see an event like this one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you're going to enjoy it very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I am! Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm super excited about getting to see my dad and Uncle Taiga performing together on stage again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You haven't heard them sing together for quite a while, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right.
I know they're going to be absolutely amazing...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I can really feel your excitement, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to clam up just now!
Umm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just reminded of some stuff, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I'm never going to get to see the three of them sing together ever again, but still...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I understand. Even though you know the truth, your heart feels what it feels.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After all, she was so important to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I'm definitely more excited for tomorrow, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know those two are gonna blow these sad feelings right out of me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's that beautiful smile of yours.
I'm feeling better, myself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, here's your milk.
And for making me smile...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A slice of cake on me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's mille-feuille!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember how you said the mille-feuille you had in New York the other day was so good?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After hearing about it, I decided to try and bake one myself. I hope you like it, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Woohoo!
Then, without further ado...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmmm!
This is amazing, MEIKO! You really are the best!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hearing you say that makes it all worth it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I feel a little better now after talking to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please have as much fun as you can tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I will...!
SONIC NOTES

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! They were so amazing!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I was completely blown away. It's hard to believe that a three-piece band could put on such a powerful performance...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Despite how large this venue is, they made it feel like we were all in the front row of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was pretty cool.
I guess this is what it means to be world-class...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: All of these artists have made this venue theirs after taking the stage. That's the biggest proof that they're top performers.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally agree.
And the crowd's been going absolutely wild.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's like they're into everything, you know?
Like they all came here to have as much fun as they can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even when that street group performed, the audience reacted really well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You always hear that Americans are expressive, but seeing it live like this is something else.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Things probably feel a little different compared to Japan, but this is pretty normal here.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Yeah, we noticed that about audiences in Japan after performing there a few times.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: People back home don't usually show what they're feeling so openly, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Japanese people might be a little less expressive compared to everyone here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but when things get going, they'll bounce off the walls like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Haha. True!
The atmosphere at RAD BLAST was pretty awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
I'm glad you guys had a good time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may have more in common with the audience over here, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He brings up a good point...
You get just about as pumped as them whenever you go to see a show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, my body just sorta starts moving on its own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Isn't it normal to cheer like crazy during a really amazing show?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
I know what you mean!
There's nothing like becoming one with everyone by cheering together!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's an integral part of a good event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Becoming one with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I might try doing that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're here in the United States, so shouldn't we try to enjoy it as much as we can?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If I can cheer just as much as the people around me, I think I'll get a better feeling for the event itself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
We can do that together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, the next group's about to take the stage!

rows.Line: Okay, I'll do that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what else have you been talking about with Mom?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: About our business and how we've been doing. That, and complaints she has about work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. Mom only ever talks about that stuff with you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, why are you snickering?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No reason. Don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Dad hasn't changed at all.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He even put on an amazing performance during SONIC NOTES.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He's still who I thought was the coolest person in the world when I was little. No, he sang better than he did back then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now I see. This has to be why Mom was able to see him off with a smile when he stepped back onto the stage.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They must be feeling pretty lonely since they don't get to be together, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? You and Uncle Taiga are gonna start singing over in the US as a team?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's the plan.
But that does mean being away from home...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess this means we're rivals now, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That probably made Mom really happy as well. I mean, she loves how cool Dad looks whenever he sings...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Make sure to show Mom just how much you appreciate her for letting you come over to the United States like this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Haha. I will.
Especially since she told me not to come back home until I've stood on top of the world, so I'm feeling real motivated.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, I have some souvenirs that I need you to take back to her. I'll give them to you a little later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I also need to figure out what to get her. And there's so much I wanna talk about...
